sa: ब्राह्मणानां यथावृत्तः क्षत्रियाणां यथाविधः॥ तथा विट्शूद्रसंघानामभवत् स प्रियस्तदा।
en: King Yudhishthria at that time became as agreeable to the Brahmanas the Kshatriyas, and the various bands of Vaishyas and Shudras of his kingdom.

sa: समेत्य मातुलं गत्वा बलदेवं च मानद। पूजयेथा महाप्राज्ञ मद्वाक्येन यथार्हतः॥
en: Meeting my maternal uncle and going to Baladeva also, O giver of honours, you well, O you of great wisdom, adore both of them at my word as they deserve.

sa: नृपतींश्चैव तान् सर्वान् सुविभक्तान् सुपूजितान्। प्रस्थापयामास वशी कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: The Kuru king Yudhishthira, having a full mastery over his senses, than dismissed the assembled kings all of whom had been properly classed and honoured by him.

sa: श्रमेण महता कृत्वा ते बिसानि कलापशः। तीरे निक्षिप्य पद्मिन्यास्तर्पणं चक्रुरम्भसा॥
en: Throwing on the ground the mass of lotuses which they had collected with great labour, they plunged once more into it for offering oblations of water to the departed Manes.

sa: यातुधान्युवाच ततस्ते मुनयः सर्वे पुष्कराणि बिसानि च। यथाकाममुपादाय समुत्तस्थुर्मुदान्विताः॥
en: The Rishis then, having, as they liked, plucked a number of lotuses and taken up a number of lotusstalks, came up from the lake filled with joy.

sa: कामानामपि दातारं कर्तारं मनसां प्रियम्। रक्षितारं न मृष्यन्ति स्वभतार्रमलं स्त्रियः॥
en: They never show sufficient regard for even such husbands as satisfy all their wishes, as always do what is agreeable to them, and as protect them from want and danger.

sa: गान्धारी चैव पुत्राणां विविधैः श्राद्धकर्मभिः॥ आनृण्यमगमत् कामान् विप्रेभ्यः प्रतिपाद्य सा।
en: Gandhari, by performing the various rites of the Sharaddha and making gifts to Brahmanas of various objects of enjoyment, became freed from the debt she owed to her slain children.

sa: स तेन कर्मणा स्पर्धन् पृथिवीं पृथिवीपते। चचार गतभीः प्रीतो लब्धकीतिवरो नृप॥
en: Priding himself upon the feat he had performed, he he wandered fearlessly and contentedly over the Earth, O monarch, honoured by all as one possessed of great fame for what he had done.

sa: गावस्तुष्टाः प्रयच्छन्ति सेविता वै न संशयः। एवमेता महाभागा यज्ञियाः सर्वकामदाः। रोहिण्य इति जानीहि नैताभ्यो विद्यते परम्॥
en: When kine are pleased with the service one renders them, they are, forsooth, capable of granting the fruition of every desire. Even so, kine are highly blessed. They are the essential articles of sacrifices. They are grantors of every wish. Know that there is nothing superior to kine.

sa: गौतम उवाच इन्द्रस्य लोका विरजा विशोका दुरन्वयाः कांसिता मानवानाम्। तस्याहं ते भवने भूरितेजसो राजन्निमं हस्तिनं यातयिष्ये॥
en: Gautama said Above them are the regions of Indra, free from passion and sorrow, which are difficult of access and coveted by all men. Going even to the abode of indra himself of great energy, I shall, O king, compel you to yield up this elephant to me.

sa: स्वयंप्रभाभिर्नारीभिर्विमानस्थो महीयते॥ रुद्रदेवर्षिकन्याभिः सततं चाभिपूज्यते।
en: Those ladies the daughters of the celestial Rishis and the Rudras, worship him with veneration.

sa: उभौ हिनस्ति न भुनक्ति चैषा या चानृते दक्षिणा दीयते वै। आघातिनी गर्हितैषा पतन्ती तेषां प्रेतान् पातयेद् देवयानात्॥
en: As those libations of clarified butter that are poured upon the extinguished ashes of a sacrificial fire never reach either the gods or the departed Manes, similarly a gift that is inade to a dancer or a singer or a Dakshina presented to a lying or deceitful person, yields no merit.

sa: देवाः समेत्य ब्रह्माणं भूमिभागे यियक्षवः। शुभं देशमयाचन्त यजेम इति पार्थिव॥
en: Having met Brahman, desirous as they were of celebrating a sacrifice on the Earth, they begged him for a piece of sacred earth, saying, We want it for our sacrifice.

sa: देवा ऊचुः भगवंस्त्वं प्रभुर्भूमेः सर्वस्य त्रिदिवस्य च। यजेमहि महाभाग यज्ञं भवदनुज्ञया॥
en: The deities said O illustrious one, you are the lord of all the Earth as also of all the gods! With your permission, O highly blessed one, we wish to perform a sacrifice.

sa: यथा नरेण कर्तव्यं धर्ममार्गनुवर्तिना। एतत् सर्वं महाबाहो भवान् व्याख्यातुमर्हति॥
en: You should, O you of mighty arms, expound as to how a man should act who is desirous of treading along the path of duty and virtue.

sa: नित्यं स्थानमुपागम्य दिव्यचन्दनभूषिताः। केन वा कर्मणा देव भवन्ति वनगोचराः॥
en: By what acts, O god, do dwellers of the forest succeed in acquiring that place which is eternal and in adoring their persons with celestial sandal paste.

sa: चतुरो मागधी सूते क्रूरान् मायोपजीविनः। मांसं स्वादुकरं क्षौद्रं सौगन्धमिति विश्रुतम्॥
en: The women of the Magadhi caste, by union with these four castes of wicked nature, produce four others who live by deceitful means. These are Mangsa, Svadukara, Kshaudra, and Saugandha.

sa: ततो वित्तं विविधं संनिधाय यथोत्साहं कारयित्वा च कोषम्। अनुज्ञातो गुरुणा संनिवृत्य शशास गामखिलां सागरान्ताम्॥
en: And with a pleased heart, the king filled his treasury with different kinds of wealth, and with the permission of his spiritual preceptor he returned (to his kingdom) and continued to rule the entire kingdom extending to the limits of the sea.

sa: नकुल उवाच हन्त वो वर्तयिष्यामि दानस्य फलमुत्तमम्। न्यायलब्धस्य सूक्ष्मस्य विप्रदत्तस्य यद् द्विजाः॥
en: The Mungoose continued : O twice-born ones, I shall presently tell you what the excellent fruit was of the gift, made by a Brahmana, of a very little measure (of powdered barley) acquired by fair means.

sa: समनुज्ञाप्य राजानं पुत्रशोकसमाहतम्। धृतराष्ट्रं सभार्यं वै पृथां च पृथुलोचनाम्॥ मूले निक्षिप्य कौरव्यं युयुत्सुं धृतराष्ट्रजम्। सम्पूज्यमानाः पौरैश्च ब्राह्मणैश्च मनीषिभिः॥
en: Taking the permission of king Dhritarashtra who was stricken with grief on account of the death of his sons, his queen (Gandhari), and Pritha also of large eyes, and keeping the Kaurava-prince Yuyutsu, the of Dhritarashtra, in the capital, they started, adored by the citizens and by many Brahmanas endued with great wisdom. son

sa: यत्र वृक्षा मधुफला दिव्यपुष्पफलोपगाः। पुष्पाणि च सुगन्धीनि दिव्यानि द्विजसत्तम॥
en: The trees there yield sweet fruits. Indeed, those trees are always bedecked with excellent flowers and fruits. Those flowers, O best of twiceborn persons, have celestial fragrance.

sa: अगाधे विमले शुद्ध सत्यतोये धृतिहदे। स्नातव्यं मानसे तीर्थे सत्त्वमालम्ब्य शाश्वतम्॥
en: Following eternal Truth one should bathe in the Tirtha called Manasa, which is unfathomable, stainless, and pure, and which has Truth for its waters and the understanding for its lake.

sa: तासां शृङ्गाण्यजायन्त यस्या यादृङ्मनोगतम्। नानावर्णाः शृङ्गरान्त्यस्ता व्यरोचन्त पुत्रक॥
en: Thereafter their horns grew and each got what each wished. Of various colours, and gifted with horns, they began to shine beautifully, O son!

sa: रात्रावहनि धर्मज्ञ जपन् पापैर्न लिप्यते। तत् तेऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमना नृप॥
en: One who recites this Mantra day and night becomes never sullied by sin. I shall now declare it to you what that Mantra is. Do you listen with rapt attention.

sa: तदद्युतमचिन्त्यं च सुमहल्लोमहर्षणम्। विस्मितः स जन: सर्वो ददर्शानिमिषेक्षणः॥
en: All persons assembled there saw with steadfast gaze and hearts filled with wonder that amazing and inconceivable scene which made the hairs stand erect.

sa: ततः स निर्विकारौ तु दृष्ट्वा भृगुकुलोद्वहः। वसु विश्राणयामास यथा वैश्रवणस्तथा॥
en: Bhishma said The perpetuator of Bhrigu's race, seeing the king and the queen totally unmoved, began to distribute wealth very largely as if he were a second Lord of Treasures.

sa: न चोषरां न निर्दग्धां महीं दद्यात् कथंचन॥ न श्मशानपरीतां च न च पापनिषेविताम्।
en: One should never give away carth that is barren or that is burnt; nor should one give away any earth that is near a crematorium, or that has been possessed and enjoyed by a sinful person before such gift.

sa: तदद्युतमचिन्त्यं च सुमहल्लोमहर्षणम्। विस्मितः स जन: सर्वो ददर्शानिमिषेक्षणः॥
en: All persons assembled there saw with steadfast gaze and hearts filled with wonder that amazing and inconceivable scene which made the hairs stand erect.

sa: धर्मलक्षणसंयुक्तमुक्तं वो विधिवन्मया। गुणानां ग्रहणं सम्यग् वक्ष्याम्यहमतः परम्॥
en: I have thus described to you duly what the characteristics are of duty. I shall, after this tell you of the comprehension of qualities.

sa: अनुमानाद् विजानीमः पुरुषं सत्त्वसंश्रयम्। न शक्यमन्यथा गन्तुं पुरुषं द्विजसत्तमाः॥
en: By inference we know that the Purusha is dependent on Goodness. O best of twice-born ones, it is impossible to attain to Purusha by any other means.

sa: यद् यदिष्टतमं लोके यच्चास्य दयितं गृहे। तत् तद् गुणवते देयं तदेवाक्षयमिच्छता॥
en: That person who wishes to make his gifts eternal, should always give to persons gifted with necessary qualifications whatever articles are desired by all and whatever things are the best in his house.

sa: नाहं मिथ्यावचो ब्रूयां स्वैरेष्वपि कुतोऽन्यथा। भवतो यदहं ब्रूयां तत्कार्यमविशङ्कया॥
en: I shall never speak a falsehood, no, not even in jest, what then need I say of other occasions? You should unhesitatingly do what I bid you.

sa: विराटद्रुपदौ चैव सहपुत्रौ ससैनिकौ। द्रौपदेयाश्च सौभद्रो राक्षसश्च घटोत्कचः॥
en: There were Virata and Drupada, with their sons and forces. There were the sons of Draupadi and the son of Subhadra, and Rakshasa Ghatotkacha.

sa: भक्तिमान् य: सदोत्थाय शुचिस्तन्द्तमानसः। सहस्रं वासुदेवस्य नाम्नामेतत् प्रकीर्तयेत्॥ यशः प्राप्नोति विपुलं ज्ञातिप्राधान्यमेव च। अचलां श्रियमाप्नोति श्रेयः प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम्॥
en: That whc with devotion and perseverance and heart wholly turned towards him, recites these thousand names of Vasudeva every day, after having purified himself, succeeds in winning great fame, an eminent position among his kinsinen, enduring prosperity, and lastly, that which is of the highest good to him (viz., Emancipation itself).

sa: वासुदेव महाबाहो सुप्रजा देवकी त्वया। त्वं नो गतिः प्रतिष्ठा च त्वदायत्तमिदं कुलम्॥
en: O Vasudeva, O mighty-armed hero Devaki, by having borne you, has come to be considered as an excellent genetrix! You are our refuge and our glory! This race (of Pandu) depends upon you for its protector.

sa: एतैः कर्मगुणैर्लोके नामाग्नेः परिगीयते॥ हिरण्यरेता इति वै ऋषिभिर्विबुधैस्तथा। पृथिवी च तदा देवी ख्याता वसुमतीति वै॥
en: It was on account of the result of this act that the Rishis and the celestials bestowed the name of Hiranyaretas upon the gods of fire. . And because the Earth held that seed she also came to be called by the name of Vasumati.

sa: इतीदं कीर्तनीयस्य केशवस्य महात्मनः। नाम्नां सहस्रं दिव्यानामशेषेण प्रकीर्तितम्॥
en: Thus I have recited to you, without any exception the thousand excellent names of the a great Keshava whose glory should always be sung.

sa: पशुसख उवाच यद् वै धर्मे परं नास्ति ब्राह्मणास्तद्धनं विदुः। विनयार्थं सुविद्वांसमुपासेयं यथातथम्॥
en: Pashusakha said The value of virtue is very superior, There is nothing superior to it. That wealth is known to the Brahmanas. I wait upon them as their servant, only for learning to prize that wealth.

sa: ततः शब्दो महाराज दिशः खं प्रति पूरयन्। बभूव प्रेक्षतां नृणां कुन्तीपुत्रं धनंजयम्॥
en: Loud was the noise which arose from that crowd of men who assembled together for seeing Dhananjaya the son of Kunti, and it seemed to fill all the points of the compass and the entire sky.

sa: ऊर्ध्वं देहाद् वदन्त्येके नैतदस्तीति चापरे। केचित् संशयितं सर्वं नि:संशयमथापरे॥
en: Some say that it continues after the body is destroyed). Others say that it does not exist. Some say that everything is doubtful. Others have no doubts.

sa: अनाहता दुन्दुभयो विनेदुर्मेघनिःस्वनाः। साधु साध्विति चाकाशे बभूव सुमहान् स्वनः॥
en: Kettle-drums struck by nobody, produced their music deep as the muttering of the clouds. A loud uproar was heard in the sky consisting of the words-Excellent, Excellent.

sa: अहस्त्रिधा तु विज्ञेयं त्रिधा रात्रिविधीयते। मासार्धमासवर्षाणि ऋतवः संधयस्तथा॥
en: The Day should be understood as threefold. The Night has been ordained to be threefold. So also are fortnights, months, years, seasons, and conjunctions.

sa: यदुप्रवीर योऽयं ते स्वस्रीयस्यात्मजः प्रभो। अश्वत्थाम्ना हतो जातस्तमुज्जीवय केशव॥
en: O Yadava hero, O powerful one this child of your sister's son, has come, out of the womb, killed by Ashvatthama. O Keshava, do you révive him!

sa: वैश्यस्य वर्तमानस्य वैश्यायां भरतर्वभ। शूद्रायां चापि कौन्तेय तयोर्विनियमः स्मृतः॥
en: If a Vaishya has two wives one of whom is a Vaishya and the other a Shudra, there is a difference between them in respect of position.

sa: पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रान्ते स कृत्वा दुष्करं तपः। कालधर्मपरीतात्मा निधनं समुपागतः॥
en: Upon the expiration of a full thousand years, Shrimat having practised the practised the severest austerities, yielded to the influence of Time and departed from this world.

sa: मन्यन्ते ब्राह्मणा एव ब्रह्मज्ञास्तत्त्वदर्शिनः। एकमेके पृथक् चान्ये बहुत्वमिति चापरे॥
en: Some Brahmanas who are conversant with Brahma and utterers of truth consider it to be one. Others, that is distinct; and others again that it is manifold.

sa: विक्षिपन् गाण्डिवं राजन् बद्धगे गङ्गुलित्रवान्। तमश्वं पृथवीपाल मदा युक्तः ससार च॥
en: Repeatedly drawing his bow, named Gandiva, O king, and casing his hand in a fence made of iguana skin, Arjuna, O monarch, prepared to follow that those, O king, with a cheerful heart.

sa: इत्युक्तः प्रतिगृह्याथ सक्तूनां कुडवं द्विजः। भक्षयामास राजेन्द्र न च तुष्टि जगाम सः॥
en: Thus addressed by them, that Brahmana accepted the Kudava (twelve double handfuls) of powdered barley which was offered to him and ate it all. But his hunger, O king, was not satisfied with what he ate.

sa: बहुशो भृशविद्धौ तौ स्रवन्तो च क्षतोद्भवम्। ददृशाते महाराज पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ॥
en: Repeatedly and deeply cut by the goad, the royal pair became covered with blood. Indeed, O king, they then looked like a couple of Kinshuka trees in the flowering season.

sa: पठेद् वा य इदं राजञ्छृणुयाद् वाप्यभीक्ष्णशः। अमांसभक्षणविधि पवित्रमृषिपूजितम्॥ विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यः सर्वकामैर्महीयते। विशिष्टतां ज्ञातिषु च लभते नात्र संशयः॥
en: He, O king, who always reads these ordinances about abstention from meat, that are sacred and worshipped by the Rishis or hears it read becomes purged off of every sin and acquire a great happiness on account of the fruition of every desire. Forsooth, he acquires an eminent position among kinsmen.

sa: गवां शतसहस्रं तु यः प्रयच्छेद् यथाविधि। परां वृद्धिमवाप्याथ स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥
en: That man who gives hundreds of thousands of kine away according to the ritual laid down in the scriptures, acquires great prosperity (here) and great honours in the celestial region.

sa: स उच्छवृत्तिस्तं प्रेक्ष्य क्षुधापरिगतं द्विजम्। आहारं चिन्तयामास कथं तुष्टो भवेदिति॥
en: The Brahmana while observing the Unchcha vow, seeing that his guest's hunger was still unsatisfied, began to think of what other food he could place before him for pleasing him.

sa: स बाध्यमान् सततं भ्रात्रा ज्येष्ठेन भारत। अर्थानुत्सृज्य दिग्वासा वनवासमरोचयत्॥
en: And always troubled by his elder brother, he, O Bharata, renouncing his riches, went to the forest, with nothing to cover his body except the open sky.

sa: मरुत उवाच दध्वा दूरं तेन न दृश्यतेऽद्या प्रपद्येऽहं शर्म विपेन्द्र त्वत्तः प्रयच्छ तस्मादभयं विप्रमुख्य॥
en: Marutta said Indeed this rain cloud floating in the air, indicates that Indra must be near at present, therefore, O prince of Brahmanas, I seek shelter from you, do you, O best of Brahmanas remove this fear of Indra from my mind.

sa: इत्याचम्य जपेत् सायं प्रातश्च पुरुषः सदा। यदह्ना कुरुते पापं तस्मात् स परिमुच्यते॥
en: Having purified oneself by touching water, one should, morning and evening, recite these Mantras every day. By this, one is sure to be purged of all the sins one may commit in course of the day.

sa: अभुक्त्वातिथये चान्नं प्रयच्छेद् यः समाहितः। स वै ब्रह्मविदां लोकान् प्राप्नुयाद् भरतर्षभ॥
en: That man, who makes a gift of food to a hungry guest arrived at his house, acquires all those regions, O chief of Bharata's race, that are reserved for persons acquainted with Brahman.

sa: न शान्तिमधिगच्छापि दुःखशोकसमाहतः। इति मे चिन्तयानस्य पितः शान्तिन विद्यते॥
en: Deeply afflicted with pain and grief, I am unable to get peace of mind. Indeed, O sire, thinking of all this, I have no peace of man.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच श्रुतं दानफलं तात यत् त्वया परिकीर्तितम्। अन्नदानं विशेषेण प्रशस्तमिह भारत॥
en: Yudhishthira said I have heard, O sire, of the merits of the different kinds of gift which you have described to me. I understand, O Bharata, that the gift of food is especially praiseworthy and superior.

sa: पानीयदानमेवैतत् कथं चेह महाफलम्। इत्येतच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि विस्तरेण पितामह॥
en: What, however, are the great merits of making gifts of drink. I wish to hear of this in full, O grandfather.

sa: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि सत्त्वक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्यथा। संयोगो विप्रयोगश्च तन्निबोधत सत्तमाः॥ विषयो विषयित्वं च सम्बन्धोऽयमिहोच्यते।
en: I shall, after this. describe how the association and the disassociation takes place of Soul and Nature. You best of men, listen. The relation here is said to be that betwcen the object and the subject.

sa: शत्रूश्चाप्यधि कौन्तेय सदा तिष्ठति तोयदः॥ सर्वकामानवाप्नोति कीर्तिं चैव हि शाश्वतीम्।
en: The giver of water, O son of Kunti, always stands over the heads of his enemies. Such a person obtains the fruition of all his desires and acquires everlasting fame.

sa: सत्यं रतिश्च धर्मश्च स्वर्गश्च गुणनिर्जितः॥ स्त्रीणां पतिसमाधीनं कांक्षितं च द्विजर्षभ।
en: Truth, pleasure, religious merit, and Heaven, as acquirable by good qualities, of women, as also all the objects of their desire, O foremost of twice-born ones, depend on the husband.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु विपुलो विषण्णवदनोऽभवत्। एवं तीव्रतापाश्चाहं कष्टश्चायं परिश्रमः॥ मिथुनस्यास्य किं मे स्यात् कृतं पापं यथा गतिः। अनिष्टा सर्वभूतानां कीर्तितानेन मेऽद्य वै॥
en: Hearing these words of theirs, Vipula's face became very sad. He began to commune with himself, I have practised severe penances. The dispute between this couple is hot. To me, again, it is painful. What sin have I committed that both these persons should refer to my end in the next world as the most painful one among those reserved for all creatures?

sa: मृत्युर्वैकिङ्करो दण्डस्तमो वह्निः सुदारुणः। घोराश्च दारुणा: पाशा नोपसर्पन्ति भूमिदम्॥
en: Mrityu, Vaikinkara, Danda, Tama, Fire, who is highly fierce, and all heinous and terrible sins are incapable of touching the person who makes a gift of earth.

sa: इत्युक्तः फाल्गुनस्तत्र धर्मराजानमब्रवीत्। विनीतवदुपागम्य वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः॥
en: Thus addressed, Phalguna, well conversant with speech, hunibly approached king Yudhishthira the just and then said these words.

sa: शतक्रतुरुवाच मन्वागमं परिवादे गजस्या तस्माद् भवान् प्रणतं मानुशास्तु ब्रवीषि यत् तत् करवाणि सर्वम्॥
en: The God of a hundred sacrifices said Yes, I am Maghavat. I come on earth for seizing this elephant. I bow to you. Do you command me. I shall immediately accomplish all that you may be pleased to say.

sa: निविशन्त्यां पुरा पार्थ द्वारवत्यामिति श्रुतिः। अदृश्यत महाकूपस्तृणवीरुत्समावृतः॥
en: Sometime before, certain youths of Yudu's race, while searching for water, came to a large well covered with grass and creepers.

sa: क्षीणे द्रव्ये गुणे ज्योतिरन्तर्धानाय गच्छति॥ व्यक्तः सत्त्वगुणस्त्वेवं पुरुषोऽव्यक्त इष्यते।
en: The flame, however, becomes put out when matter and quality (or oil and wick) are exhausted. Thus Nature is manifest; while Purusha is said to be unmanifest.

sa: क्रियतां निखिलेनैतन्मा विचारय पार्थिव॥ तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा राजा भृत्यांस्तथाब्रवीत्। यद् यद् ब्रूयान्मुनिस्तत्तत् सर्वं देयमशङ्कितैः॥ ततो रत्नान्यनेकानि स्त्रियो युग्यमजाविकम्। कृताकृतं च कनकं गजेन्द्राचाचलोपमाः॥ अन्वगच्छत तमृषि राजामात्याश्च सर्वशः।
en: Let all this be done, O king, and do not entertain any scruples!-Hearing these words of the Rishi, the king called his servants and told them-Ye should without any fear, give away whatever the ascetic will command. Then profuse jewels and gems and beautiful women, and pairs of sheep, and coined and uncoined gold, and huge elephants resembling, hills or mountain summits, and all the ministers of the king, began to follow the Rishi as he was carried on that chariot.

sa: नारद उवाच एवमुक्त्वा महादेवः श्रोतुकामः स्वयं प्रभुः। अनुकूलां प्रियां भार्यां पार्श्वस्थां समभाषत॥
en: Narada said Having said these words, the powerful Mahadeva himself become desirous of hearing, and with that view he questioned his dear wife who was seated by his side and was bent upon doing his will.

sa: ततः स राजा कौरव्यः कुन्तीपुत्रश्च वीर्यवान्। भीमसेनादयश्चैव प्रत्युत्थायाभ्यवादयन्॥
en: The Kuru king Dhritarashtra, Kunti's son Yudhishthira of great energy, and Bhimasena and others, stood up and going a few steps, saluted those guests.

sa: एवं संचिन्तयन्नेव विपुलो राजसत्तम। अवाङ्मुखो दीनमना दध्यौ दुष्कृतमात्मनः॥
en: Thinking thus, Vipula, O best of kings, hung down his head, and with a dispirited mind began to recollect what sin he had done.

sa: अदितिः कश्यपस्याथ सर्वास्ता: पतिदेवताः। पृष्टाश्चोपासिताश्चैव तास्त्वया देवि नित्यशः॥
en: Kashyapa has Aditi. All these consider their husbands as their gods. You have, O goddess, conversed and associated with all of them every day.

sa: अव्यक्तं क्षेत्रमुद्दिष्टं गुणानां प्रभवाप्ययम्। सदा पश्याम्यहं लीनो विजानामि शृणोमि च॥
en: The unmanifest lives in the symbol called. Kshetra, and is that in which the qualities are produced and absorbed. I always see, know, and hear it (though) it is hidden.

sa: अथात्रिस्तं तथा दृष्ट्वा पुत्रशोकेन कर्षितम्। भृशमाश्वासयामास वाग्भिरिष्टाभिरव्ययः॥
en: Seeing him greatly stricken with grief consequent on the death of his son, the immortal Atri comforted him with agreeable advice.

sa: तथा प्रशंसते दीपान् यमः पितृहितेप्सया। तस्माद् दीपप्रदो नित्यं संतारयति वै पितॄन्।॥
en: Like the gift of water, Yama, from desire of doing good to the departed manes, applauds the gift of lamps to light dark places, for it is considered as benefiting the departed manes.

sa: वसिष्ठ उवाच शतं वर्षसहस्राणां तपस्तप्तं सुदुष्करम्। गोभिः पूर्वं विसृष्टाभिर्गच्छेम श्रेष्ठतामिति॥
en: Vasishtha said The kine which had been created in former age practised the hardest penances for a hundred thousand years with the objects of acquiring a position of great preeminence.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच भूय एवं कुरुश्रेष्ठ दानानां विधिमुत्तमम्। कथयस्व महाप्राज्ञ भूमिदानं विशेषतः॥
en: Yudhishthira said Do you, O foremost one of Kuru's family, describe to me once again the excellent ordinances about gifts, with especial reference, O you of great wisdom, to the gift of earth.

sa: तथैव गाः प्रशंसन्ति न तु देयं ततः परम्। संनिकृष्टफलास्ता हि लघ्वाश्च युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Likewise are kine praised. There is no object of gift higher than they. Kine are supposed to confer merit forthwith. They are also, O Yudhishthira, such that a gift of them cannot but yield great merit.

sa: पितोवाच रूपेण सदृशस्त्वं मे शीलेन च दमेन च। परीक्षितश्च बहुधा सक्तूनादह्यि ते सुत॥
en: The Father said In forin you are like me. In conduct and in self-control, also you are my like. You have been examined on various occasions by me. I shall, therefore, accept your share of the barley, O son!

sa: लोभमास्थाय योऽस्माकं विषमं कर्तुमुत्सहेत्। विपुलस्य परे लोके या गतिस्तामवाप्नुयात्॥
en: He, amongst us who, led by cupidity, will act in an unfair way, shall meet with that end which is reserved for Vipula in the next world.

sa: यद्येतत् त्वं प्रतिश्रुत्य न करोषि वचः शुभम्। सकलं वृष्णिशार्दूल मृतां मामवधारय॥
en: If having pledged yourself previously you do not accomplish your auspicious vow, do you then know for certain, O chief of the Vrishni race, that I shall put an end to my life.

sa: असूयको नरश्चापि मृतो जायति शार्ङ्गकः। विश्वासहर्ता तु नरो मीनो जायति दुर्मतिः॥
en: That man who has malice towards others, has, after death, to take birth as a sharngaka. That wicked man who becomes guilty of breach of trust has to take birth as a fish.

sa: श्रोत्रेण गधनादत्स्व स्पर्शानादत्स्व जिह्वया। त्वचा च शब्दमादत्स्व बुद्ध्या स्पर्शमथापि च॥
en: Do you also take smells by the car, and sensations of touch by the tongue. Do you also take sounds by the skin, and like wise touch by the understanding.

sa: एतत् कारणमाज्ञाय दृष्ट्वा देवासुरं पुरा। युद्धं पिता मे हृष्टात्मा विस्मितः समपद्यत॥
en: Seeing the battle between the celestials and the Asuras in days of old, and understanding the power of the instructions that fell from the Brahmanas, my father became filled with delight and wonder.

sa: त्वया तु तारितोऽस्म्यद्य किमन्यत्र तपोबलात्। अनुजानीहि मां कृष्ण गच्छेयं दिवमद्य वै॥
en: By you I have been saved today. What else can it testify than the power of your penances? Let me have your permission, O Krishna. I wish to ascend to the celestial region.

sa: देवास्तु पितरो नाम निर्मिता ये स्वयम्भुवा। उष्णपा ये महाभागास्तेषां भाग: प्रकल्पितः॥
en: Those deities named Pitris were created by the SelfCreate. Others also, highly blessed, viz., the Ushmapas, were created by him. For all these, shares have been sanctioned of the offerings made at Shraddhas.

sa: भाजनानि च लौहानि पात्रीश्च विविधा नृप। यद् यदिच्छति यावच्च यच्चान्यदपि भाजनम्॥
en: Various kinds of vessels, made of iron, and smaller vessels and cups of various sizes, were also given away by the king, the ascetics taking them away, each as many as he liked.

sa: यथास्थानं च तौ स्थित्वा भूयस्तं संववाहतुः। अथापरेण पार्बेन सुष्वाप स महामुनिः॥
en: Seated once more by his side, they again began to gently press his feet as before. Meanwhile the great ascetic continued to sleep soundly as before. Only, he now lay on another side.

sa: आदित्यः सत्त्वमुद्रिक्तं कुचरास्तु तथा तमः। परितापोऽध्वगानां च रजसो गुण
en: The Sun is Goodness developed; men of evil deeds represent Ignorance; the heat which travellers on their way feel, is said to be a quality of Darkness.

sa: तत्र जीवति वर्षाणि त्रयोदश युधिष्ठिर। अधर्मसंक्षये युक्तस्ततो जायति मानवः॥
en: Assuming such a form, O Yudhishthira, he has to live for thirteen years. Upon the exhaustion of his sin by such sufferance, he regains the human form.

sa: तडागकृद् वृक्षरोपी इष्टयज्ञश्च यो द्विजः। एते स्वर्गे महीयन्ते ये चान्ये सत्यवादिनः॥
en: That Brahmana who excavates a tank, and he who plants trees, and he who performs sacrifices, are all adored in the celestial region as men who are devoted to truth fullness of speech.

sa: एवमेवानुमन्येरस्तान् भवान् द्रष्टुमर्हति। तेषामनुमतं श्रुत्वा शक्या कर्तुं विचारणा॥
en: You should see them who can givc their consent in this. After hcaring their consent, the matter will become a worthy topic for consideration.

sa: सुरर्षिदेवगन्धर्वा ये च देवपुरःसराः॥ स्तुवन्तो देवदूताश्च स्थिता दानेन विस्मिताः।
en: The celestial Rishis, the deities, the Gandharvas, those who walk before the deities, and the celestial messengers, are all lauding you, struck with wonder at your gift.

sa: सप्तावरान् सप्त परान् पितूंस्तेभ्यश्च ये परे। पुमांस्तारयते गङ्गां वीक्ष्य स्पृष्ट्वावगाह्य च॥
en: By seeing that sacred river, touching it, and bathing in its waters, one rescues his ancestors to the seventh degree, and his descendants to the seventh degeree, as also other ancestors and descendants.

sa: ममन्वेनाभिभूत: संस्तत्रैव परिवर्तते॥ नावं न शक्यपारुह्य स्थले विपरिवर्तितुम्।
en: Overcome by the idea of mineness, one wanders within its narrow embarking on a boat it is not possible in moving about on land.

sa: मवोचं वै प्रभविष्णुं पुराणम्। क्षीरस्यैताः सर्पिषश्चैव नद्यः शश्वत्स्रोताः कस्य भोज्याः प्रदिष्टा॥
en: Seeing all those objects, I addressed the ancient and powerful judge of the dead, saying For whose use and enjoyment have these rivers with eternal currents of milk and clarified butter been ordained?

sa: न त्वां याजयिताऽस्म्यद्य वृणु यं त्वमिहेच्छसि। उपाध्यायं महाबाहो यस्ते यज्ञं करिष्यति॥
en: O you of mighty arms, I am unable to act as your priest now. And according to your own desire, you can appoint any one as your priest who will perform your sacrifice.

sa: किन्नरोरगरक्षांसि देवगन्धर्वमानवाः। तथा ऋषिगणाश्चैव संश्रयन्ति महीरुहान्॥
en: Kinnaras, Uragas, Rakshasas, deities Gandharvas, and human beings, as also Rishis, all resort to trees as their refuge.

sa: अपूर्वमकृतं नित्यं य एनमविचारिणम्। य एवं विन्देदात्मानमग्राह्यममृताशनम्। अग्राह्योऽमृतो भवति स एभिः कारणैर्भुवः॥
en: He who thus understands the Soul to which there is nothing prior, which is uncreated, immutable, unconquered, and incomprehensible even to those who are eaters of nectar, certainly becomes himself incomprehensible and immortal through these means.

sa: बाह्यद्रव्यविमुक्तस्य शारीरेषु च गृङ्ख्यतः। यो धर्मो तत् सुखं चैव द्विषतामस्तु तत् तथा॥
en: The virtue and happiness which one attains who has renounced only the external objects, but who at the same time possessed by passions and weakness of the flesh, let these be the portion of our enemies.

sa: प्रतिग्रहेण तेजो हि विप्राणां शाम्यतेऽनघ। प्रतिग्रहं ये नेच्छेयुस्तेभ्यो रक्ष्यं त्वया नृप॥
en: The energy and power of Brahmanas, o sinless one, become abated by the acceptance of gifts. You should protect your family, O king, from those Brahmanas who do not desire to accept gifts.

sa: यानि नामानि गौणानि विख्यातानि महात्मनः। ऋषिभिः परिगीतानि तानि वक्ष्यामि भूतये॥
en: All those names, derived from His attributes, secret and wellknown, of the great Vasudeva, which were sung by the Rishis, I shall recite to you for the good of all.

sa: एवमावेदयामासुर्मुनयस्ते ममानघ। ये ते भागीरथीतीरे मया दृष्टा युधिष्ठिर॥
en: O sinless one, this is what the ascetics have told me, those viz., whom I saw on the banks of sacred Bhagirathi, O Yudhishthira.

sa: पर्वतानां महामेरुः सर्वेषामग्रजः स्मृतः। दिशां च प्रदिशां चोर्ध्वं दिक्पूर्वा प्रथमा तथा॥
en: Of all the mountains the great Meru is said to be the first-born. Of all the cardinal and subsidiary points of the horizon, the eastern is said to be the foremost and first-born.

sa: देवेभ्यश्च पितृभ्यश्च संथितेभ्यस्तथैव च। अवशिष्टानि यो भुङ्क्ते तमाहुर्विघसाशिनम्॥
en: He who eats what remains after serving the celestials, the departed Manes, and relatives and dependants, is said to eat Vighasa or the residue.

sa: पञ्चवार्षिकमेवं तु क्षत्रियस्य फलं स्मृतम्। ततोऽर्धेन तु वैश्यस्य शूद्रो वैश्यार्धतः स्मृतः॥
en: That man who sells himself and with the proceeds thereof purchases kini and gives them away to Brahmanas, enjoys happiness in Heaven for as long a period as kin are seen on Earth.

sa: रूपमव्यङ्गतामायुर्बुद्धिं सत्त्वं बलं स्मृतिम्। प्राप्तुकामैनरैहिंसा वर्जिता वै महात्मभिः॥
en: Those great inen who desire beauty, faultessness of limbs, long life, understanding mental and physical strength, and memory should abstain from acts of injury.

sa: दुर्योधनापराधेन कर्णस्य शकुनेस्तथा। दुःशासनचतुर्थानां कुरवो निधनं गताः॥
en: Indeed, through the fault of Duryodhana, of Karna, of Shakuni, and of Dushasana as the fourthi, that the Kurus have died.

sa: भीष्म उवाच मांसस्याभक्षणाद् राजन् यो धर्मः कुरुनन्दन। तन्मे शृणु यथातत्त्वं यथास्य विधिरुत्तमः॥
en: Bhishma said Listen to me, O scion of Kuru's race, what the merit is of abstention from meat. Listen to me as I declare to you what the excellent ordinances, in sooth, are on this subject.

sa: चित्तं चित्तादुपागम्य मुनिरासीत संयतः। याच्चित्तं तन्मयो वश्यं गुह्यमेतत् सनातनम्॥
en: Attaining pure knowledge from (restraining) the mind, the ascetic should sit self-controlled. One necessarily becomes that on which one's mind is set. This is an eternal mystery.

sa: फलानि च विचित्राणि राजभोज्यानि भूरिशः। बदरेङ्गुदकाश्मर्यभल्लातकफलानि च॥
en: Various sweet fruits fit to be eaten by kings, were also there. There were Vadaras and Ingudas and Kahsmaryyas and Bhallatakas.

sa: किराता यवनाश्चैव तास्ताः क्षत्रियजातयः। वृषलत्वमनुप्राप्ता ब्राह्मणानाममर्षणात्॥ ब्राह्मणानां परिभवादसुराः सलिलेशयाः। ब्राह्मणानां प्रसादाच्च देवाः स्वर्गनिवासिनः॥
en: On account of their having disregarded the Brahmanas, the Asuras have been obliged to take refuge in the depths of the ocean. Through the favour of the Brahmanas, the celestials have become denizens of the happy regions of Heaven.

sa: बाल एव महाबाहुश्चकार कदनं महत्। कंसस्य पुण्डरीकाक्षो ज्ञातित्राणार्थकारणात्॥
en: The lotus-eyed and mighty-armed Vasudeva, while yet a child performed the great feat of killing Kansa for the relief of his kinsmen. eyes like

sa: संस्कृतासंस्कृताः पक्वा लवणालवणास्तथा। प्रजायन्ते यथा भावास्तथा चित्तं निरुध्यते॥
en: Well-dressed, cooked with salt or without salt, meat, in whatever form one may take it, by and by attracts the mind and enslaves it.

sa: एष तस्यानवद्यस्य नारदस्य महात्मनः। संदेशो देवपूजार्थं तं तथा कुरु पाण्डव॥
en: This is the behest of the sinless and highsouled Narada. He has commanded such adoration of the great god. O son of Pandu, do you obey that command of Narada.

sa: असंवासाः प्रजायन्ते म्लेच्छाश्चापि न संशयः। नराः पापसमाचारा लोभमोहसमन्विताः॥
en: Those sinful men who yield to the influence of cupidity and stupefaction, are surely born as Mlechchhas who are uriworthy of being associated with.

sa: धारयिष्यति यश्चैनं महापुरुषसम्भवम्। शृणुयात् कथयेद् वा यः स श्रेयो लभते परम्॥
en: He who will remember that discourse when coming out from a foremost person, he who will listen to it, and he who will recite it, is sure to acquire what is highly beneficial.

sa: विनयाचारहीनाश्च अशिवाश्च नराधमाः। ते भवन्ति शिवा विप्र ये वै गङ्गामुपाश्रिताः॥
en: Those wretched men who are destitute of humility or modesty of behaviour and who are greatly sinful, become righteous and good, O Brahmana, by living by the side of Ganga.

sa: महाभाग कथं यज्ञेष्वागमो नृपसत्तम। यष्टव्यं पशुभिर्मुख्यैरथो बीजै रसैरिति॥
en: O highly blessed one, what is the Vedic declaration about sacrifices? Is it preferable to perform sacrifices with animals or with seeds and juices.

sa: तपो यज्ञः श्रुतं शीलमलोभः सत्यसंधता। गुरुदैवतपूजा च एता वर्तन्ति भूमिदम्॥
en: Penances, sacrifice, Vedic learning, good conduct, absence of cupidity, firmness in truth, adoration of elders, preceptors, and the deities, all these live in him who makes a gift of earth.

sa: शतक्रतुस्तु तद् वाक्यमृषिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः॥ उक्तं न प्रतिजग्राह मानान्मोहवशं गतः।
en: were The deity of a hundred sacrifices, however, moved by pride and overwhelmed by stupefaction, did not accept these words uttered by the Rishis.

sa: न चान्यदिह कर्तव्यं किञ्चिदूर्ध्वं यथाविधि। गुप्तो गोपायते ब्रह्मा श्रेयो वस्तेन शोभनम्॥
en: A Brahmana should never do anything else than what has been laid down for him. Protected they should protect others. By acting thus, they are sure to acquire what is for their behoof.

sa: अन्नस्य हि प्रदानेन नरो रौद्रं न सेवते। तस्मादन्नं प्रदातव्यमन्यायपरिवर्जितम्॥
en: By making gifts of food, one has never to go to hell. Hence one should always make gifts of food, having got it by fair means. a

sa: आलम्भसमये तस्मिन् गृहीतेषु पशुष्वथा महर्पयो महाराज बभूवुः कृपयान्विताः॥
en: The time came for killing the animals. When the animals selected for sacrifice were seized, the great Rishis, O king, felt mercy for them.

sa: एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातमन्नदानफलं महत्। मूलमेतत् तु धर्माणां प्रदानानां च भारता॥
en: I have thus told you all about the great merit of gifts of food. This is the root of all virtue and merit, as also of all gifts, O Bharata.

sa: कच्चित् ते पृथुलश्रोणि नाप्रियं प्रियदर्शने। अकार्षमहमज्ञानादयं वा बभ्रुवाहनः॥
en: I hope, O you of ample hips, that neither I, nor this Babruvahana here, have, O beautiful lady, donc any injury to you unconsciously?

sa: स कस्मिंश्चित् क्षुधाविष्टः फलभारसमन्वितम्। बिल्वं ददर्श विप्रर्षिरारुरोह च तं ततः॥
en: After he had proceeded for some distance, he became stricken with hunger. He there saw a Bilva tree covered down with the weight of (ripe) fruits. He climbed that tree.

sa: ततो ध्यात्वा च भगवान् ब्रह्मा तममितौजसम्। अयं श्रेष्ठ इति ज्ञात्वा ववन्दे तमुमापतिम्॥
en: Then reflecting with the help of his penances, the Illustrious Grandfather Brahman found out that that child was the foremost of al! beings, the lord of Uma, Mahadeva of immeasurable prowess. He then lauded the Lord.

sa: तस्मादसि मया पुत्र युद्धाय परिचोदितः। मा पापमात्मनः पुत्र शङ्केथा ह्यण्वपि प्रभो॥
en: It was, therefore, O son, that you were urged by me to fight. O powerful king, O son, do not suspect that you have committed any, even the least, fault, by his challenge.

sa: रत्नोपकीर्णा वसुधां यो ददाति पुरंदर। स मुक्तः सर्वकलुषैः स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥
en: That person, O Purandara, who makes a gift of earth rich with jewels and gems becomes purged off of all his sins and is highly respected in the celestial region.

sa: ये च धर्माः शुभाः पुण्याः सरहस्या उदाहृताः। तेषां धर्मफलं तस्य यः पठेत जितेन्द्रियः॥
en: That man who, with his senses under thorough restraint, reads these sections describing these auspicious and meritorious duties, together with their mysteries duties, that have been ascribed (by the previous speakers), acquires all the merits of their actual performance.

sa: ब्राह्मणा ज्ञानसम्पन्ना यथावच्छ्रुतनिश्चयाः। इतरं कृतपुण्यं वा तं विजानन्ति लक्षणैः॥ यथान्धकारे खद्योतं लीयमानं ततस्ततः। चक्षुष्मन्तः प्रपश्यन्ति तथा च ज्ञानचक्षुषः॥ पश्यन्त्येवंविधं सिद्धा जीवं दिव्येन चक्षुषा। च्यवन्तं जायमानं च योनि चानुप्रवेशितम्॥ तस्य स्थानानि दृष्टानि त्रिविधानीह शास्त्रतः। कर्मभूमिरियं भूमिर्यत्र तिष्ठन्ति जन्तवः॥
en: He becomes equipped on all sides with all his auspicious deeds of merit and with all his sins. Brahmanas gifted with knowledge and equipped with the certain conclusions of the scriptures, know him, from marks, as to whether he is possessed of merit or with its demerit. Even as men having eyes see the firefly appearing and disappearing in the midst of darkness, men having the eye of knowledge and crowned with success of penances, see, with spiritual vision, the Individual Soul as he leaves the body, as he is re-born, and as he enters the womb. It is seen that the Individual Soul has three regions assigned to him eternally.

sa: यत्र वक्ष्यसि तत्र त्वां नयिष्यामि सुराधिप। इत्युक्तो नहुषस्तेन योजयामास तं मुनिम्॥
en: O lord of the celestials, I shall bear you to the spot which you may be pleased to direct! Thus addressed by him. Nahusha caused the ascetic to be yoked to his car.

sa: न हि दत्तस्य दानस्य नाशोऽस्तीह कदाचन। चित्रगुप्तमतं श्रुत्वा हृष्टरोमा विभावसुः॥
en: A gift made to worthy person never goes for nothing. It is sure to yield agreeable results to the giver. Hearing these opinions of Chitragupta the Sun's hairs stood erect.

sa: दशायुतानि चाश्वानां गोऽयुतानि च विंशतिम्। पुष्करेषु द्विजातिभ्यः प्रादां शतसहस्रशः॥
en: By the side of the Pushkara lake I made gifts to the Brahmanas, for a hundred thousand times, a hundred thousand horses, and two hundred thousand kine.

sa: तेन ज्यातलघोषेण सर्वे लोकाः समाकुलाः। बभूवुरवशाः पार्थ विषेदुश्च सुरासुराः॥
en: On account of the iwang of his bowstring the whole universe became agitated. The celestials and the Asuras, O son of Pritha, all became cheerless and stupefied.

sa: स तत्र गोयं पिबति पानीयं यः प्रयच्छति। प्रदीपस्य प्रदानेन श्रूयतां गुणविस्तरः॥
en: He who makes gifts of water in this world, drinks from that river in the next world when he goes there, listen now to the profuse merits accruing from the gift of lamps.

sa: महेश्वरश्च लोकानां महतामीश्वरच सः। बहुभिर्विविधै रूपैर्विश्वं व्याप्तमिदं जगत्। तस्य देवस्य यद् वक्त्रं समुद्रे वडवामुखम्॥
en: Because he is the master of the vast universe, therefore he is called Maheshvara. The whole universe is pervaded by him in various forms. His mouth roars and burns the waters of the sea in the form of the huge mare's head.

sa: ह्रियमाणं तु तं दृष्ट्वा गौतमः संशितव्रतः। अभ्यभाषत राजानं धृतराष्ट्र महातपाः॥ मा मेऽहार्षीहस्तिनं पुत्रमेनं दुःखात् पुष्टं धृतराष्ट्राकृतज्ञ। मैत्रं सतां सप्तपदं वदन्ति मित्रद्रोहो मैव राजन् स्पृशेत् त्वाम्॥
en: Seeing the elephant dragged away, the great ascetic Gautama of rigid vows said to king Dhritarashta, O ungrateful Dhritarashtra, do not rob me of this elephant. It is considered by me as a son and I have reared it with much pain. It is said that between the pious, friendship if formed by merely the exchange of seven words. You should see, O king, that the sin of injuring a friend does not affect you,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तः स राजर्षिर्धर्मराजेन धीमता। कौन्तेयं समनुज्ञातुमियेष भरतर्षभ॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus addressed by the highly intelligent and just king Yudhishthira, the royal sage, Dhritarashtra, O chief of the Bharatas, wished to obtain the king's permission.

sa: न तु कश्चिन्नयेत् प्राज्ञो गृहीत्वैव करे नरम्। उच्यमानस्तु धर्मेण धर्मलोकभयच्छले॥
en: A wise man cannot catch holds of a sinful person and forcibly make him pious. When seriously urged to act piously the sinful only act with hypocrisy, moved by fear.

sa: समृद्धः सम्प्रयच्छ त्वं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो युधिष्ठिर। धेनूरनडूहोऽन्नानि च्छत्रं वासांस्युपानहौ॥
en: Yourself being rich, do you, Yudhishthira, make gifts to Brahmans of kine and bullocks and food and umbrellas and robes and sandals or shoes.

sa: वरुणश्चादितो विप्र जग्राह प्रभुरीश्वरः। कविं तात भृगुं चापि तस्मात् तौ वारुणो स्मृतौ।।
en: The powerful and supreme Lord Mahadeva in the form of Varuna which he had assumed for this sacrifice had first, О learned Brahmana, adopted both Kavi and Angirasa. Hence, these two are considered as of Varuna.

sa: सर्वकामदुधां धेनुं सर्वकामगुणान्विताम्। ददाति यः सहस्राक्ष स्वर्ग याति स मानवः॥
en: That man who gives away a cow endued with every accomplishment and granting the fruition of every desire, succeeds O you of a thousand eyes, in attaining the celestial region.

sa: यत् प्रशस्तं च लोकेषु पुण्यं यच्च शुभाशुभम्। तत्सर्वं केशवोऽचिन्त्यो विपरीतमतः परम्॥
en: All that is noble and meritorious in the universe, all that is good and evil, is Keshava who is inconccivable. Hence, it is absurd to think of anything which is superior to Keshava.

sa: मतङ्ग सम्प्रधायँवं यदहं त्वामचूचुदम्। वृणीष्व काममन्यं त्वं ब्राह्मण्यं हि सुदुर्लभम्॥
en: Knowing this for certain, O Matanga that I say to you do you name some other boon, for the status of a Brahmana is incapable of being acquired by you.

sa: श्रूयतां चापरो धर्मो मनुष्याणां सुखावहः। श्रद्दधानेन कर्तव्यः सहरस्यो महाफलः॥
en: Listen to another duty whose observance yields happiness to mankind. It should be observed its secret ritual by a person having faith. Its merits are certainly high.

sa: एतत् सर्वं यथान्यायं कुर्वीथा भूरिदक्षिणा प्रियस्तथा प्रजानां त्वं स्वर्गे सुखमवाप्स्यसि॥
en: O giver of profuse presents in sacrifices, you should duly do all this. You shall, by acting thus, become dear to your subjects and acquire happiness in the celestial region.

sa: प्रीताः प्रीणन्ति सततं मानिता मानयन्ति च। अवज्ञातावधूताश्च निर्दहन्त्यधमान् नरान्॥
en: Pleased, they gratify their worshippers. Honoured they make their worshippers enjoy all honors. Disregarded and insulted, they make those vilest of men to be ruined and consumed.

sa: तमद्भुतमचिन्त्यं च दृष्ट्वा मुनिगणस्तदा। विस्मितो दृष्टरोमा च बभूवास्राविलेक्षणः॥
en: Seeing that wonderful and inconceivable spectacle, al the ascetics became filled with wonder. Their hair stood erect and their vision was disturbed with tears.

sa: उपतिष्ठन्ति पुण्यानि सदा भूमिप्रदं नरम्। शङ्खभद्रासनं छत्रं वराश्वा वरवाहनम्॥
en: Sweetscented flowers, an excellent conch and excellent seat, an umbrella and excellent horses with good vehicles, are always ready for the person who makes gifts of earth.

sa: एतन्मे संशयं सर्वे याथातथ्यमनिन्दिताः। ऋषयो वक्तुमर्हन्ति निश्चितार्थं तपोधनाः॥
en: These Rishis having penances for wealth and freed from every stain, should explain to me truly this doubt which has originated in my mind.

sa: तस्मिन्नुपरते शब्दे मुहूर्तादिव भारत। निगृह्य बाष्पं धैर्येण धर्मराजोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: When those sounds of wailing ceased for a while, king Yudhishthira the just, shopping his tears by summoning all his patience, said these words.

sa: इत्येतत् सर्वदानानां श्रेष्ठमुक्तं तवानघ। मया भरतशार्दूल किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि॥
en: I have thus, O chief of the Bharatas, described to you that gift which is the foremost of all gifts. What else do you wish to hear?

sa: ततः प्रकृतिमापन्नो भार्गवो नृपते नृपम्॥ उवाच श्लक्ष्णया वाचा तर्पयन्निव भारत। राजन् सम्यग् जितानीह पञ्च पञ्च स्वयं त्वया।।३५ मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि कृच्छ्रान्मुक्तोऽसि तेन वै।
en: After this, O monarch, the son of Bhrigu, without guile or insincerity of any sort, pleased the king with many soft words, and then saido king, you have completely subjugated the five organs of action and the five organs of knowledge with the mind as their sixth. For this you have come out unhurt from the fiery ordeal I had prepared for you.

sa: सर्वथैव महाराज शरीरं धारयेदिह। प्रेत्य चेह च कर्तव्यमात्मनिःश्रेयसं परम्॥
en: By all means, O king, should the body be protected. One should do what is highly beneficial for one both in this world and in the next.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्तो मतङ्गस्तु संशितात्मा यतव्रतः। अतिष्ठदेकपादेन वर्षाणां शतमच्युतः॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by Indra, Matanga of restrained vows and wellcontrolled soul, stood for a century of years on one foot, O you of unfading glory.

sa: ततो ममात्मा यो देहे सोऽग्निर्भूत्वा विनिः सृतः। गतश्च वरदं द्रष्टुं सर्वलोकपितामहम्॥
en: On account of iny penances, the Soul existing in my body became changed into fire and came out of my mouth. That fire had gone to see the boongiving Grandfather all the universe.

sa: एतद् वः परमं गुह्यं कथितं द्विजसत्तमाः। यन्मां भवन्तः पृच्छन्ति सूक्ष्मतत्त्वार्थदर्शिनः॥
en: You foremost of twice born persons, this is a great mystery that I declare it to you in reply to your question, you who know the truths of all subjects.

sa: पिण्डदास्तस्य हीयन्ते न च प्रीणाति वै पितॄन्। अतिथिर्यस्य भग्नाशो गृहात् प्रतिनिवर्तते॥
en: The performer of the Shraddha who gives away such offerings to such a Brahmana, losses prosperity and multiplies not his race. He fails, again to gratify his Pitris by doing such an act.

sa: धारिणी सर्वभूतानां पृथिवी गन्धलक्षणा। स्वरव्यञ्जनसंस्कारा भारती शब्दलक्षणा॥
en: Earth, which holds all entities, has smell for its characteristic. Speech has words for its characteristic, refined into vowels and consonants.

sa: तस्मादग्निपराः सर्वे देवता इति शुश्रुम। ब्रह्मणो हि प्रभूतोऽग्निरग्नेरपि च काञ्चनम्॥
en: Hence, it is that we have heard that all the celestials consider Agni as their refuge and are devoted to him. Agni originated from Brahman, and from, Agni originated gold.

sa: जिज्ञासुह्येष पुत्रस्य बलस्य तव कौरवः। संग्रामे युद्ध्यतो राजन्नागतः परवीरहा।॥
en: O you of Kuru's race, desirous of ascertaining the prowess of yourself, his son, this destroyer of hostile heroes, O king, came here for fighting with you.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच एवं संचोदितः सिद्धः प्रश्नांस्तान् प्रत्यभाषत। आनुपूर्येण वार्ष्णेय तन्मे निगदतः शृणु॥
en: The Brahmana said Thus urged by Kashyapa, the Liberated Sage answered those questions one after another. Do you listen to me, O hero of the Vrishni race, as I recite to you the answers he gave.

sa: कथेयमभवत् तत्र त्वया या परिकीर्तिता। सुमनोधूपदीपानां सम्प्रदाने फलं प्रति॥ ततः पप्रच्छ दैत्येन्द्रः कवीन्द्रं प्रश्नमुत्तमम्॥
en: This very subject which you have introduced regarding the merits of the gift of flowers and incense and lamps, came up on the occasion. Indeed the king of the Daityas put this high question of Shukra that most learned of all ascetics.

sa: अन्नमूर्जस्करं लोके प्राणाश्चान्ने प्रतिष्ठिताः। अन्नेन धार्यते सर्वं विश्वं जगदिदं प्रभो॥
en: In this world, food is the root of energy and strength. The vital airs are established on food. It is food that keeps up the wide universe, O powerful one.

sa: भगवानुवाच असुरस्तारको नाम त्वया दत्तवरः प्रभो। सुरानृषीश्च क्लिश्नाति वधस्तस्य विधीयताम्॥
en: The Deities said The Asura named Taraka who has received boons from you, O powerful one, is assailing the celestials and the Rishis. Let his death be ordained by you.

sa: तं तथा तपसा युक्तमुवाच हरिवाहनः। मतङ्ग तप्स्यसे किं त्वं भोगानुत्सृज्य मानुषान्॥
en: The king of the celestials, viz., Indra, appeared to him thus practising penances and said Why, O Matanga, do you pass your time in such grief, abstaining from all sorts of human enjoyments.

sa: अस्माभिः परिपृष्टश्च यदाह भरतर्षभ। दिव्येन विधिना पार्थ नच्छृणुष्वाविचारयन्॥
en: Listen, O son of Pritha, unhesitatingly to what he, O chief of Bharata's race, said, in answer to our enquiries, according to heavenly forms.

sa: भीष्म उवाच सम्प्रहस्य ततो विष्णुरिदं वचनमब्रवीत्। चक्रेण निहता दैत्याः पद्भ्यां क्रान्ता वसुन्धरा॥
en: Bhishma said Hearing these words of Indra, Vishnu smiled a little and then said, It was with my circular disc that the Daityas were killed. It was with my two feet that the world was covered.

sa: य एतां दक्षिणां दद्यादक्षयां राजसत्तम। पुनर्नरत्वं सम्प्राप्य भवेत् स पृथिवीपतिः॥
en: That person, O best of kings, who gives away earth, which is indestructible, as gift, is born in next life as a man and becomes also a lord of Earth.

sa: च्यवनः समनुप्राप्य कुशिकं वाक्यमब्रवीत्। वस्तुमिच्छा समुत्पन्ना त्वया सह ममानघ॥
en: Going then to the presence of king Kushika, Chyavana said to him,—o sinless one, the desire has arisen in my heart of living with you for sometime.

sa: मामेवादत्त मां दत्त मां दत्त्वा मामवाप्स्यथ। अस्मिल्लोके परे चैव तद् दत्तं जायते पुनः॥
en: The verse to which I refer is this. Receive me in gift. Give me away. By giving me away, you (O giver) will obtain me again! That which is given away in this life is reacquired in the next.

sa: इत्येवं चिन्तयानः स विदितश्च्यवनस्य वै॥ सम्प्रेक्ष्योवाच नृपति क्षिप्रमागम्यतामिति।
en: These thoughts that passed through the king's mind, became known to Chyavana. Ascertaining the king's thoughts, the Rishi addressed him and saidCome here quickly.

sa: दास्यामि भवते कन्यामिति पूर्वं न भाषितम्। ये चाहर्ये च नाहर्ये ये चावश्यं वदन्त्युत॥
en: In matters of marriage, some fathers say-I shall bestow my daughter upon such and such a person; some say-~-I shall not bestow my daughter upon such a one:—Some, again, say forcibly—I must bestow my daughter upon such an individual.

sa: दश चेव पितॄन् माता सर्वां वा पृथिवीमपि। गौरवेणाभिभवति नास्ति मातृसमो गुरुः॥
en: The mother is equal to ten fathers or even the whole Earth. There is no senior equal to the mother. Indeed, she is above all in respect of the reverence due to her.

sa: साधून् गृहस्थान् दृष्ट्वा च तथा साधून् वनेचरान्। मुक्तांश्चावसथे सक्तांस्तेनासि हरिणः कृशः॥
en: Having no wealth and accomplishments you try in vain to remove the grief of your friends and the sorrows of sorrowing men. It is for this that you are so pale and lean.

sa: उत्साहप्रभुशक्तिभ्यां मन्त्रशक्त्या च भारत। उपपन्नो नृपो यायाद् विपरीतं च वर्जयेत्॥
en: Only that king, O Bharata, who is gifted with alacrity, discipline, and strength of counsels should march against an enemy. When his position is otherwise, he should avoid offensive works.

sa: शाश्वतस्याव्ययस्याथ यदस्य ज्ञानमुत्तमम्। प्राच्यमानं मया विप्र निबोधेदमशेषतः॥
en: Do you, O learned Brahmana, understand in full what form the excellent knowledge, as I declare it, of that indestructible seat.

sa: तस्मात् त्वमपि विप्रेभ्यः प्रयच्छ कनकं बहु। ददत्सुवर्णे नृपते किल्बिषाद् विप्रमोक्ष्यसि॥
en: Do you also, therefore, make profuse gift of gold to the Brahmanas. Indeed, O king, by making such gifts of gold, you will surely be purged of all you sins.

sa: तस्मात् त्वमपि विप्रेभ्यः प्रयच्छ कनकं बहु। ददत्सुवर्णे नृपते किल्बिषाद् विप्रमोक्ष्यसि॥
en: Do you also, therefore, make profuse gift of gold to the Brahmanas. Indeed, O king, by making such gifts of gold, you will surely be purged of all you sins.

sa: स तां वाचं गुरोः पत्न्या विपुलः पर्यवर्तयत्। भो: किमागमने कृत्यमिति तस्यास्तु निःसृता॥
en: The words therefore, that actually dropped from her lips were What is the reason of your coming here? These words adorned with grammatical refinements, came out of her mouth that was as beautiful like the moon.

sa: तं प्रभिन्नं महानागं प्रस्रुतं पर्वतोपमम्। धृतराष्ट्रस्य रूपेण शक्रो जग्राह हस्तिनम्॥
en: One day, Indra, in the guise of king Dhritarashtra, scized that powerful clephant which was as huge as a hill and from whose rent temples the juice was trickling down.

sa: अवराणां समानानां शिष्याणां च समाचरेत्। पापमाचक्षते नित्यं हृदयं पापकर्मिणः॥
en: Such a word can be used to those who are inferior, or equal, or to disciples. A sinful man always speaks of the sins he has committed.

sa: सोऽब्रवीन्मातरं कुन्तीं वनं तमनुजग्मुषीम्। अहं राजानमन्विष्ये भवती विनिवर्तताम्॥
en: Seeing that his other Kunti was desirous of retiring into the forest, the king said to her, 'I shall follow the old king. Do

sa: तांश्चापि विजयो जित्वा नातितीव्रण कर्मणा। तुरङ्गमवशेनाथ सुराष्ट्रानभितो ययौ॥
en: Subjugating those tribes without having to perform any terrific feats, Arjuna proceeded to the country of the Saurashtras, his footsteps guided by the horse.

sa: ततस्ता वर्धमानस्य कुमारस्य महात्मनः। तेजसाभिपरीताङ्ग्यो न क्वचिच्छम लेभिरे॥
en: As the great Kumara, however, began to grow within their wombs their bodies being possessed by his energy, they could not get peace anywhere.

sa: कुशिक उवाच भगवन् सहधर्मोऽयं पण्डितैरिह धार्यते। प्रदानकाले कन्यानामुच्यते च सदा बुधैः॥
en: Kushika said O holy one, to live together is a deed which the learned ordain for girls wheir these are given away. The wise always speak of the practice in such connection only.

sa: ततः सेनापतिरभूत् कर्णो दौर्योधने बले। अक्षौहिणीभिः शिष्टाभिर्वृतः पञ्चभिराहवे॥
en: After that, Karna became the Cominanderin-chief of Duryodhana's forces. He was supported in battle by the residue of the Kaurava-army which numbered five Akshauhinis.

sa: तन्निबोध महाबाहो सर्वं निगदतो मम। अग्नीषोमात्मकमिदं सुवर्णं विद्धि निश्चये॥
en: Listen to me, O you of mighty arms, as I describe these subjects. Know this as certain that gold is of the essence of Fire and Moor.

sa: अथागम्य महातेजा नारदोऽकथयद् विभो। यथा हता महाभागैस्तेजसा ब्राह्मणैः कपाः॥
en: Then coming there, O king, the highly energetic Narada informed the deities how their enemies, the Kapas, had been really killed by the Brahmanas of mighty cnergy.

sa: वर्णतो गुणतश्चैव योनितश्चैव तत्त्वतः। सर्वमेतत्तमो विप्राः कीर्तितं वो यथाविधि॥
en: With respect then to its colour, its characteristics, and its source, I have, you learned Brahmanas, declared to you, accurately and in due order, everything, about Ignorance.

sa: ततोऽन्यस्मिन् वनोद्देशे पुनरेव ददर्श तम्। कौश्यां वृस्यां समासीनं जपमानं महाव्रतम्॥
en: The king then saw the Rishi at another part of that forest, seated on a mat made of Kusha grass, and mentally engaged in the recital of some high Mantras.

sa: प्रणवांश्चापि भवति रूपवांश्च तथा नृप। अन्नदः प्राणदो लोके सर्वदः प्रोच्यते तु सः॥
en: The giver of food is said to be the giver of life. Indeed, he is said to be the giver of everything. Hence, O king, such a acquires both strength and personal grace in this world.

sa: श्रीश्चैव रमते तुषे धारयन्ति श्रियं च ते॥ वृथादारान् न गच्छन्ति वृथामांसं न भुञ्जते।
en: The goddess of Prosperity sports among them, and they, in their turn, support her with respect. They They never know their wives uselessly, and they never eat the flesh of such animals as have not been killed in sacrifices.

sa: ननु त्वमार्यधर्मज्ञा ननु चासि पतिव्रता। यत्त्वत्कृतेऽयं पतितः पतिस्ते निहतो रणे॥
en: Do you know the practices of the respectable? Are you a wife devoted to you husband? It is through your deed, that your husband is land low, slain in battle.

sa: अन्नं हि दत्त्वातिथये ब्राह्मणाय यथाविधि। प्रदाता सुखमाप्नोति दैवतैश्चापि पूज्यते॥
en: If food be given duly to a Brahmana come to one's house as a guest, the giver acquires great happiness, and is adored by the very celestials.

sa: द्रव्याणां संचयश्चैव कर्तव्यः सुभहांस्तथा। यदा समर्थो यानाय नचिरेणैव भारत।॥
en: The king should collect a large quantity of articles (for his commissariat). When able to march out, he should on no account make a delay, O Bharata.

sa: संनिरुद्धस्तु तेनात्मा सर्वेष्वायतनेषु च॥ जगाम भित्त्वा मूर्धानं दिवमभ्युत्पपात ह।
en: The vital airs, restrained and unable to escape through any of the outlets, at last passed through the crown of the head and proceeded upwards to Heaven.

sa: पौषमासं तु कौन्तेय भक्तेनैकेन यः क्षिपेत्। सुभगो दर्शनीयश्च यशोभागी च जायते॥
en: That man, O son of Kunti, who passes the whole month of Pausha abstaining every day from one of two meals, becomes a gainer of good fortune and pleasant features and great fame.

sa: हते कर्णे तु कौरव्या निरुत्साहा हतौजसः। अक्षौहिणीभिस्तिसृभिर्मद्रेशं पर्यवारयन्॥
en: After the fall of Karna, the Kauravas became dispirited, and lost all energy. Numbering three Akshaushinis, they gathered round the king of the Madras.

sa: माघं तु नियतो मासमेकभक्तेन यः क्षिपेत्। श्रीमत्कुले ज्ञातिमध्ये स महत्त्वं प्रपद्यते॥
en: He who passes the whole month of Magha, abstaining every day from one of the two mcals, is born in a high family and attains to a position of eminence among his kinsmen.

sa: अन्नं ह्यमृतमित्याह पुराकल्पे प्रजापतिः। अन्नं भुवं दिवं खं च सर्वमन्ने प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: In a former Age, the Lord of all creatures said that food is ambrosia or the source of immortality. Food is Earth, Food is Heaven, Food is the Sky. Everything rests on food.

sa: विपुल उवाच अजितेन्द्रिय दुर्बुद्धे पापात्मक पुरन्दर। न चिरं पूजयिष्यन्ति देवास्त्वां मानुषास्तथा॥
en: Vipula said O wicked Purandara, O you of sinful mind, o wretch who have no control over your senses, neither the deities nor human beings will worship you for any length of time.

sa: रक्षाविधानं मनसा स संचिन्त्य महातपाः॥ आहूय दयितं शिष्यं विपुलं प्राह भार्गवम्।
en: Gifted with high ascetic merit, he at last hit upon the course he should adopt. Summoning his favourite disciple whose name was Vipula and who was of Bhrigu's family, he said as follows.

sa: तथामात्या जनपदा दुर्गाणि विविधानि च। बलानि च कुरुश्रेष्ठ भवत्येषां यथेच्छकम्॥
en: You should sec that the ministers of state, the pcople of the provinces, the garrisons of forts, and the forces, O foremost one of Kuru's race, are not tampered with.

sa: वायु उवाच ततः कर्म समारब्धं हिताय सहसाश्विनोः। च्यवनेन ततो मन्त्रैरभिभूताः सुराऽभवन्॥
en: The god of wind said Then Chyavana, taking the Ashvins with him, began a great religious rite for their bencfit. The gods all became stupefied by Chyavana with the help of his Mantras.

sa: च्यवन उवाच पिबेतामश्विनौ सोमं भवद्भिः सहिताविमौ। उभावेतावपि सुरौ सूर्यपुत्रौ सुरेश्वर॥
en: Chyavana said The twin Ashvins shall drink Soma with all of you. Both of them are gods, O king of the celestials, for they are the sons of the Sun.

sa: मेघेवूय संनिधत्ते प्राणानां पवनः पतिः। तच्च मेघगतं वारि शक्रो वर्षति भारत॥
en: The deity of wind, places above the clouds (the water drawn by the Sun). The water thus taken to the clouds is caused by Shakra to be poured upon the Earth, O Bharata.

sa: तन्निमित्तं महाबाहो दानं दद्यास्त्वमुत्तमम्। सदैव भ्रातृभिः सार्धं सूर्यजस्यारिमर्दन॥
en: O crusher of enemies, I hope you will, with all your brothers, make excellent gifts for the sake of that son of the Sun-God.

sa: सहकारान् प्रफुल्लांश्च केतकोद्दालकान् वरान्। अशोकान् सहकुन्दांश्च फुल्लांश्चैवातिमुक्तकान्॥
en: And he saw many Sahakaras adorned with blossoms, and Ketakas and Uddalakas, and Dhavas, and Ashokas and blossoming Kundas, and Atimuktas.

sa: आदत्ते च रसान् भौमानादित्यः स्वगभस्तिभिः वायुरादित्यतस्तांश्च रसान् देवः प्रवर्षति॥
en: The Sun, by means of his rays, draws up the moisture of the Earth. The god of wind cause the moisture to fall down from the Sun.

sa: यन्निर्दहति यत्तीक्ष्णो यदुनो यत् प्रतापवान्। मांसशोणितमज्जादो यत् ततो रुद्र उच्यते॥
en: And because he burns and oppresses, is keen and fierce, and gifted with great energy, and is engaged in cating flesh and blood and marrow, that he is called Rudra.

sa: संस्कृत्य च कुरुश्रेष्ठं गाङ्गेयं कुरुसत्तमाः॥ जग्मुर्भागीरथीं पुण्यामृषिजुष्टां कुरूद्वहाः।
en: Having thus cremated the body of the son of Ganga those foremost ones of Kuru's race proceeded the sacred Bhagirathi, accompanied by the Rishis.

sa: जितशिश्नोदरो मैत्रः शिष्टाचारसमन्वितः। वैणवीं धारयेद् यष्टिं सोदकं च कमण्डलुम्॥
en: One should govern his lust and stomach, practise universal compassion, and be characterised by good conduct. One should bear a bamboo-stick, and a water-pot filled with water.

sa: सर्वे त्वौपयिकाः कालाः कार्याणां भरतर्षभ। तथैवालंकृतः काले तिष्ठेथा भूरिदक्षिण॥
en: At the proper time, adorning your body, you should sit prepared to make gifts in profusion. The turns for different deeds, O son, ceaselessly revolve like wheels.

sa: तस्मात् सुवर्णं मङ्गल्यं रत्नमक्षय्यमुत्तमम्। सहजं कार्तिकेयस्य वह्नस्तेजः परं मतम्॥
en: Gold is the powerful energy of the god of fire and was born with Kartikeya. Hence is gold highly sacred, valuable, and excellent and has unending merit.

sa: शुचिदेहः सदा दक्षो वननित्यः समाहितः। एवं युक्तो जयेत् स्वर्ग वानप्रस्थो जितेन्द्रियः॥
en: With body always in a state of purity, gifted with cleverness, ever living in the forest, with concentrated mind, and senses, in subjection, a hermit, thus devoting himself, would conquer the celestial region.

sa: ऊषतुस्तत्र ते देव्यौ महार्हशयनासने॥ सु पूजिते स्वयं कुन्त्या पार्थस्य हितकाम्यया।
en: The two ladies took up their residence there, using costly beds and seats, treated with affection and honor by Kunti herself from desire of doing what was agreeable to Partha.

sa: इत्युक्तवचने कृष्णे भृशं क्रोधसमन्वितः। उत्तङ्क इत्युवाचैनं रोषादुत्फुल्ललोचनः॥
en: When Krishna had said these words, Utanka, filled with anger, and with eyes expanded in rage, addressed him in these words.

sa: अहं दानं प्रशंसामि भवानपि तपःश्रुते। तपः पवित्रं वेदस्य तपः स्वर्गस्य साधनम्॥
en: Following them I highly speak of gift. You highly speak of penances and Vedic learning. Penances are sacred. Penances are the means by which one may acquire the Vedas and the celestial region.

sa: मधुरास्तु कथाचित्राश्चित्रार्थपदनिश्चयाः। निश्चप्रज्ञः स पार्थाय कथयामास केशवः॥
en: Then Keshava, knowing thc full significance of all matters, addressed Partha in sweet and beautiful words of excellent style and meaning.

sa: अपूजिताश्च यत्रैताः सर्वास्तत्राफला: क्रियाः। तदा चैतत् कुलं नास्ति यदा शोचन्ति जामयः॥
en: There where women are not adored, all acts become fruitless. If the women of a family, on account of the treatment they receive, indulge in grief and tears, that family soon becomes extinct.

sa: महेश्वर उवाच अहिंसा सत्यवचनं सर्वभूतानुकम्पनम्। शमो दानं यथाशक्ति गार्हस्थ्यो धर्म उत्तमः॥
en: Maheshvara said Abstention from injury, truthfulness of speech, mercy towards all beings, tranquillity of soul, and the making of gifts to the best of one's power, form the foremost duties of the householder.

sa: सर्वकामफलाश्चापि वृक्षा भवनसंस्थिताः॥ वाप्यो वीथ्यः सभाः कूपा दीर्घिकाश्चैव सर्वशः।
en: Within those mansions are many trees capable of satisfying every desire of the inmates. Many tanks and roads and halls and wells and lakes are all there.

sa: तस्मादपि स कौरव्य गन्धारविषयं हयः। विचचार यथाकामं कौन्तेयानुगतस्तदा॥
en: Thence, O king, the horse proceeded to the country of the Gandharas. Arrived there, it roamed at will, followed by the son of Kunti.

sa: तद् भागिनेयनिधनं तत्त्वेनाचक्ष्व मे प्रभो॥ सदृशाक्षस्तव कथं शत्रुभिर्निहतो रणे।
en: O powerful one, tell me in full of the destruction of your sister's son! Having eyes resembling thine, alas, how was he killed in battle by enemies.

sa: तथा मत्स्यैः परिवृतं च्यवनं भृगुनन्दनम्। आकर्षयन्महाराज जालेनाथ चदृच्छया॥
en: And as they dragged their net, o king, they easily dragged up Chyavana the son of Bhrigu, along with a large number of fish.

sa: प्रतियातु भवान् क्षिप्रं तपस्तप्स्याम्यहं विभो। इहैव शोषयिष्यामि तपसेदं कलेवरम्॥ पादशुश्रूषणे रक्तो राज्ञो मात्रोस्तथानयोः। तमुवाच ततः कुन्ती परिष्वज्य महाभुजम्॥
en: Do you return to the capital soon. I shall practice penances, O powerful one! Even here I shall reduce my body by penances, engaged in serving the feet of the king and of these my mothers!' To Kunti, after embracing that mighty armed here, addressed him thus, Depart, O son! Do not say so.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच इदं मे तत्त्वतो राजन् वक्तुमर्हसि भारत। अहिंसयित्वापि कथं ब्रह्महत्या विधीयते॥
en: Yudhishthira said O descendant of Bharata's race, you should answer this question of mine truly and in detail. What are those circumstances under which a person may become guilty of Brahmanicide without actually killing a Brahmana.

sa: त्वं हि तात महाबुद्धे सुखमेष्यसि शोभनम्। सुखात् सुखतरप्राप्तिमाप्नुते मतिमान्नरः॥
en: You, O son will rise from joy to greater joy (for performing the duty of making gifts.). The intelligent man certainly rises from joy to greater joy.

sa: गोषु भक्तश्च लभते यद् यदिच्छति मानवः। स्त्रियोऽपि भक्ता या गोषु ताश्च काममवाप्नुयुः॥
en: The man who is devoted to kine succeeds in getting the fruition of every desire of his. Indeed, even those women who are devoted 10 kine succeed in securing the fulfilment of every desire of theirs.

sa: यानीमान्युत्तमानीह वेदोक्तानि प्रशंससि। तेषां श्रेष्ठतरं दानमिति मे नात्र संशयः॥
en: All those rites laid down in the Vedas which you highly speak of, do not equal a gift for, gift is undoubtedly fraught with very superior merit.

sa: एष द्विजजने धर्मो गार्हस्थ्यो लोकधारणः। द्विजानां च सतां नित्यं सदैवैष प्रवर्तते॥
en: Even these are the duties of a twice born householder. Those duties really upholds the world. Those duties always and eternally emanate from those pious persons among the Brahmanas who live like householders.

sa: गङ्गाद्वारे कुशावर्ते बिल्वके नीलपर्वते। तथा कनखले स्नात्वा धूतपाप्मा दिवं व्रजेत्॥
en: Bathing in Gangadvara and Kushavarta and Vilvaka in the Blue mountains, as also in Kanakhala, one is sure to become purged of all one's sins and then ascend to heaven.

sa: नास्वादयीत भुञ्जानो रसांश्च मधुरांस्तथा। यात्रामात्रं च भुञ्जीत केवलं प्राणधारणम्॥
en: He should not also eat such kinds of food as have a sweet taste. He should eat only so inuch as is necessary to keep him alive.

sa: नैवं तु शक्र कर्तव्यं पुनर्मान्याच ते द्विजाः। मा गम: ससुतामात्यः क्षयं ब्रह्मबलार्दितः॥
en: You should not, O Shakra, do its like again. The Brahmanas should be respected by you. See that you do not, with your sons and counsellors, meet with destruction, afflicted by the power of the Brahmanas.

sa: तमपृच्छत् ततो राजा कुशिकः प्रणतस्तदा। किमन्नजातमिष्टं ते किमुपस्थापयाम्यहम्॥
en: Bowing to the Rishi, King Kushika asked him, saying-What kind of food is liked by you? What food, indeed, shall be brought for you.

sa: अध्वा सूर्येण निर्दिष्टः कीटवच्च चरेन्महीम्। दयार्थं चैव भूतानां समीक्ष्य पृथिवीं चरेत्॥
en: He should move about the world like a worm, having his path pointed out by the Sun. From mercy for creatures, he should walk on the Earth with his eyes directed towards it.

sa: अमरोऽस्मीति यबुद्धि समास्थाय प्रवर्तसे। मावमंस्था न तपसा नसाध्यं नाम किंचन॥
en: You think that you are an immortal and that, therefore, are at liberty to act thus. Do not, however, dishonour the Brahmanas. Know that there is nothing unattainable by penance.

sa: देवा मनुष्यगन्धर्वा: पितरोरगराक्षसाः। स्थावराणि च भूतानि संश्रयन्ति जलाशयम्॥
en: The celestials, human beings, Gandharvas. Departed Manes Uragas, Rakshasas, and even immobile beings, all resort to a tank full of water as their refuge.

sa: शोचितव्यं न पश्यामि त्वया धर्मभृतां वर॥ शोचितव्यं मया चैव गान्धार्या च महीपते।
en: O foremost of the pious, I do not see why you should grieve. O king, having lost a century of sons like wealth got in a dream, it is Gandhari and I, who should raelly mourn.

sa: पाण्डवाश्चातिदीनास्ते दुःखशोकपरायणाः। यानैः स्त्रीसहिताः सर्वे पुरं प्रविविशुस्तदा॥
en: The Pandavas, exceedingly cheerless and stricken with grief and sorrow accompanied by their wives, returned to the city, on their cars.

sa: प्रातरुत्थाय तान् राजन् पूजयित्वा यथाविधि। कृत्यकाले समुत्पन्ने पृच्छेथाः कार्यमात्मनः॥
en: Rising early in the morning, O king, adore them with due rites, and when the time comes for action, you should consult them about your (intended) acts.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच ततस्तु तस्या ब्राह्मण्या मतिः क्षेत्रज्ञसंक्षये। क्षेत्रज्ञानेन परतः क्षेत्रज्ञेभ्यः प्रवर्तते॥
en: The holy one said Then the mind of the Brahmana's wife, upon the destruction of the Kshetrajna, became that which is beyond Kshctrajna, on account of the knowledge of Kshetra.

sa: विद्यावृद्धान् सदैव त्वमुपासीथा युधिष्ठिर। शृणुयास्ते च यद् ब्रूयुः कुर्याश्चैवाविचारयन्॥
en: You should always, O Yudhishthria, honour those persons who are old in learning. You should listen to what they would say, and act accordingly without any scruple.

sa: देवदारुमयौ द्वौ तु यूपौ कुरुपतेर्मखे। श्लेष्मातकमयं चैकं याजका: समकल्पयन्॥
en: Two stakes were set up by the priest which were made of Devadaru in that sacrifice of the Kuru king, and one which was made of Shleshmataka.

sa: हंससारसयुक्तं च विमानं लभते नरः। इन्द्रलोके च वसते वरस्त्रीभिः समावृतः॥ तृतीये दिवसे यस्तु प्राचीयादेकभोजनम्। सदा द्वादशमासांस्तु जुह्वानो जातवेदसम्॥ अग्निकार्यपरो नित्यं नित्यं कल्यप्रबोधनः। अतिरात्रस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम्॥
en: up from Surrounded by the most beautiful ladies, he lives in the region of Indra. That man who takes only one meal every third day, and pours libations every day on his sacred fire for a period of a whole year, indeed, he who thus attends to his fire every day and wakes sleep every morning before sun rise, acquires the high merit of the Atiratra sacrifice. He acquires a car drawn by peacocks and swans and cranes.

sa: इत्युक्तो वचनात् तस्य नारदेन जलेश्वरः॥ मुञ्च भार्यामुतथ्यस्य कस्मात् त्वं हृतवानसि।
en: Thus requested by Utathya, the celestial Rishi Narada went to where Varuna was and addressing him, said, Do you liberate the wife of Utathya. Indeed, why have you abducted her!

sa: मयूरहंसयुक्तं च विमानं लभते नरः। सप्तर्षीणां सदा लोके सोऽप्सरोभिर्वसेत् सह॥
en: Proceeding to the region of the seven Rishis, he lives there, surrounded by Apsaras of great beauty. It is wellknown that such residence lasts for full three Padmas of years.

sa: ततो रात्र्यां व्यतीतायां कृतपुर्वाह्निकक्रियाः॥ हुत्वाग्निं विधिवत् सर्वे प्रययुस्ते यथाक्रमम्।
en: When the night passed away, thcy all arose from their beds and performed their morning acts. Pouring libations then on the sacred fire, they continued their journey.

sa: शोकसंतप्तहृदया रुदती वेपती भृशम्। मणिपूरपतेर्माता ददर्श निहतं पतिम्॥
en: Her heart burning with sorrow, weeping piteously the while, and trembling all over, the mother of the king of Manipura saw her killed husband.

sa: बुद्ध्यायं गम्यते मार्गः शरीरेण न गम्यते। आद्यन्तवन्ति कर्माणि शरीरं कर्मबन्धनम्॥
en: This path can be trodden with the help of the understanding and not of the body. Actions have both beginning and end, and the body has actions for its fetters.

sa: ननु नामाद्य वैराटि श्रुत्वा मम गिरं सदा। भवनान्निष्पतत्याशु कस्मान्नाभ्येति ते पतिः॥
en: Alas, O daughter of Virata, as soon he heard my voice, he used to come out of his chamber without the loss of a moment. Why does not your husband come out today.

sa: विश्रान्ताय ततस्तस्मै सहासीनाय भार्यया। निवेदयामास तदा विपुलः शक्रकर्म तत्॥
en: After his preceptor had rested a while and when he was seated with his wife on the same seat, Vipula told him everything that Shakra had done.

sa: स्त्रीप्रत्ययो हि वै धर्मो रतिभोगाश्च केवला:। परिचर्या नमस्कारास्तदायत्ता भवन्तु वः॥
en: The virtue of men depends upon women. All pleasures and enjoyments also entirely depend upon them. Do you serve them and adore them. Do ye bend your wills before them.

sa: किं तपो ब्रह्मचर्यं वा गोभिः कृतमिहेश्वर। देवानामुपरिष्टाद् यद् वसन्त्यरजसः मुखम्॥
en: What austerities, what Brahmacharya, O lord, did kine perform on account of which they are able to live happily in a region that is even above that of the celestials.

sa: पूर्वाभाद्रपदायोगे राजमाषान् प्रदाय तु। सर्वभक्षफलोपेतः स वै प्रेत्य सुखी भवेत्॥
en: By making gifts, under the constellation Purva Bhadrapada, of Rajamasha, one acquires great happiness in next life and comes by a profuse supply of every kind of food and fruits.

sa: साहं त्यक्त्वा गमिष्यामि भूमित्वं ब्रह्मणः पदम्। अयं सराष्ट्रो नृपतिर्मा भूदिति ततोऽगमत्॥
en: Renouncing my character as the soil, I shall now go to my father. Let this king with all his kingdom meet with destruction! Forming this conclusion, she departed for the region of Brahman.

sa: वर्षाकाले तडागे सलिलं यस्य तिष्ठति। अग्निहोत्रफलं तस्य फलमाहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: The wise have said that man acquires the merit of an Agnihotra sacrifice in whose tank water is held in the season of rains.

sa: नेमामर्हसि मूढानां वृत्तिं त्वमनुवर्तितुम्। पितृपैतामहं वृत्तिमास्थाय धुरमुद्वह॥
en: Therefore you should not act like a stupid; but following the course of your forefathers, sustain the burthen (of the Empire).

sa: स यज्ञः शुशुभे तस्य साक्षाद् देवर्षिसंकुलः। गन्धर्वगणसंगीतः प्रवृत्तोप्सरसां गणैः॥
en: That sacrifice looked greatly beautiful as if adorned with the celestial Rishis, with the Gandharvas singing in chorus and the various tribes of Apsaras dancing in merriment.

sa: ऋते दधि घृतेनेह न यज्ञः सम्प्रवर्तते। तेन यज्ञस्य यज्ञत्वमतो मूलं च कथ्यते॥
en: No sacrifice can be performed without the help of curds and clarified butter. The very character as sacrifice which sacrifices have, depends upon clarified butter. Hence clarified butter is considered as the very root of sacrifice.

sa: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य बलवत् पाकशासनिः। नाराचमग्निसंकाशं प्राहिणोद् वारणं प्रति॥
en: Seeing the beast once more advancing towards him, Arjuna shot with great strength an arrow at it which resembled a veritable flame of fire.

sa: ऋषिधर्मं तु धर्मज्ञ श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यतः परम्। स्पृहा भवति मे नित्यं तपोवननिवासिषु॥
en: you who are conversant with every religion, I wish to hear what the high Religion is of the Rishis. I always have a liking for those who live in hermitage.

sa: राजपुत्र सुखं प्राप्य क्रतूंश्चैवाप्तदक्षिणान्। अथ मोदिष्यसे स्वर्गे ब्रह्मभूतोऽव्ययः सुखी॥
en: O prince, enjoying much happiness and celebrating many sacrifices with profuse presents, you shall attain to Heaven and, changed into eternal Brahma, you shall enjoy perfect beatitude.

sa: मम ते दर्शनं प्राप्तं तच्च वै सुकृतं त्वया। तिर्यग्योनौ स्म जातेन मम चाभ्यर्चनात् तथा॥ इतस्त्वं राजपुत्रत्वाद् ब्राह्मण्यं समवाप्स्यसि। गोब्राह्मणकृते प्राणान् हुत्वाऽऽत्मानं रणाजिरे॥
en: You were able to obtain a sight of my body. That was an act of merit to you while you were a worm. On account of your having saluted and worshipped me, you shall rise higher for, from the Kshatriya order you shall rise to the status of a Brahinana, if only you die on the field of battle for the sake of kine or Brahmanas.

sa: कथंचित् तक्षको मुक्तः सत्यत्वात् तव पार्थिव। ऋषयः पूजिताः सर्वे गतिर्दृष्टा महात्मनः॥
en: Through your truthfulness, o king, Takshaka has with difficulty escaped a painful fate. The Rishis have been all adored. You have seen also he end that has been acquired by your great father.

sa: प्रसादात् सत्यसंधस्य भवतोऽमिततेजसः। यदहं कीटतां प्राप्य सम्प्राप्तो राजपुत्रताम्॥
en: Through your favour who are firm in truth and gifted with immeasurable energy, I who was before a worin have now become a Kshatriya.

sa: एवमुक्तः स शान्तात्मा तामुवाच हसन्निव। सुभगे नाभ्यसूयामि वाक्यस्यास्य तवातघे॥
en: Thus questioned, that Brahmana of tranquil soul then said to her, smilingly, O blessed dame, I am not offended with these words of yours, O sinless one.

sa: देविकायामुपस्पृश्य तथा सुन्दरिकाह्रदे। अश्विन्यां रूपवर्चस्कं प्रेत्य वै लभते नरः॥
en: Bathing in Devika and the lake known by the name of Sundarika as also in the Tirtha called Aslivini, one acquires, in next life, great personal beauty.

sa: तत्र देवाधिदेवस्य कुमार्यो रमयन्ति तम्॥ द्वात्रिंशद् रूपधारिण्यो मधुरा: समलंकृताः।
en: The daughters of the king of the dcities gladden him there. Those damsels, of agreeable manners and adorned with every ornament, are capable of assuming thirty-two forms.

sa: उष्ट्राश्वतरयुक्तानि यानानि च वहन्ति माम्। सबान्धवः सहामात्यश्चाश्नामि पिशितौदनम्॥
en: Numerous cars to which are attached camels and mules bear me. With all my relatives and friends I now eat food rich with meat.

sa: उत्तरां त्वमवेक्षस्व गुर्विणी मा शुचः शुभे। पुत्रमेषा हि तस्याशु जनयिष्यति भाविनी॥
en: Do you cast your eyes on Uttara, who is quick with child. O blessed lady do not give way to grief. This auspicious girl will soon bring forth a son to that hero!

sa: मासानष्टौ पार्षतेन रौरवेण नव प्रभो। गवयस्य तु मांसेन तृप्तिः पितॄणां माहिषेण तु॥
en: With venison got from those deer that are called Prishata, they remain pleased for eight months, and with that obtained from the Ruru for nine months, and with the meat of the Gavaya for ten months.

sa: अपि नः स्वकुले जायाद् यो नो दद्यात्त्रयोदशीम्। मधासु सर्पिःसंयुक्तं पायसं दक्षिणायने॥
en: He who has taken birth in our race, should give us Payasa mixed with clarified butter on the thirteenth day (of the dark fortnight), under the constellation Magha, during the Sun's southward course.

sa: विदिताः क्षत्रधर्मास्ते येषां युद्धेन जीविका॥ तथा प्रवृत्तो नृपतिर्नाधिबधेन युज्यसे।
en: You know the duties of the Kshatriyas, who live by warfare. A king who has done his duty, should not allow himself to be overwhelmed by grief.

sa: एवं स निधनं प्राप्तो दौहित्रस्तव मानद। संतापं त्यज दुधर्ष मा च शोके मनः कृथाः॥
en: It was thus, O giver of honours, that your daughter's son was killed. Cast off your burning grief, O irresistible one! Indeed, do not set your heart on sorrow. burning grief, O irresistible one! Indeed, do not set your heart on sorrow.

sa: नाहमात्मार्थमिच्छामि रसानास्येऽपि वर्ततः। आपो मे निर्जितास्तस्माद् वशे तिष्ठन्ति नित्यदा।।१९
en: I do not wish for my own self those tastes which exist in contact with even my tongue. Therefore, water, subjugated by me, is always under me.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ब्राह्मणान् न परीक्षेत क्षत्रियो दानधर्मवित्। दैवे कर्मणि पित्र्ये तु न्यायमाहुः परीक्षणम्॥
en: Bhishma said The Kshatriya who is conversant with the ordinances about gift, should never examine Brahmanas. In all matters, however, relating to the worship of the deities and the departed Manes, an examination has been said to be proper.

sa: स हि राजा महानासीत् केकयेषु परंतपः। स्वपुत्रं मनुजैश्वर्ये निवेश्य वनमाविशत्॥
en: Shatayupa, O scorcher of enemies had been the great king of the Kaikeyas. Having made over the sovereignty of his kingdom to his son, he had come into the forest,

sa: महाह्रद उपस्पृश्य शुद्धेन मनसा नरः। एकमासं निराहारो जमदग्निगतिं लभेत्॥
en: Bathing in the tirtha called Mahahrada with a purified heart and after fasting for one month, one is sure to acquire the status of the sage Jamadagni.

sa: नापराधोऽस्ति सुभगे नराणां बहुभार्यता। प्रमदानां भवत्येष मा तेऽभूद् बुद्धिरीदृशी॥
en: O blessed lady, polygamy is no fault with men. Women only commit sin by taking more than one husband. Do not, therefore, cherish such thoughts (of vengeance).

sa: शङ्कमानास्त्वन्योन्यं पप्रच्छुर्द्विजसत्तमाः। त ऊचुः समयं सर्वे कुर्म इत्यरिकर्षन॥
en: Bhishma said Those foremost of twiceborn persons, suspecting one another, o destroyer of enemies, said We shall each have to swear to our innocence.

sa: धृत्या तुष्टो नरेन्द्रः स गान्धारी विदुरस्तथा॥ शौचेन चाजातशत्रोर्न तु भीमस्य शत्रुहन्।
en: Both Gandhari and Vidura also were well pleased with the power which the king having no enemics showed for bearing wrongs. They were, however, not so pleased, O destroyer of foes, with Bhima.

sa: स्त्रियश्च पुरुषेष्वेव प्रत्यक्षं लोकसाक्षिकम्। अत्र मे संशयस्तीवो हृदि सम्परिवर्तते।॥
en: Likewise, women, too, are seen to attach themselves to men. All this is seen taking place everywhere in the world. I have a doubt on this subject.

sa: दुःखं हि मृत्युर्भूतानां जीवितं च सुदुर्लभम्। अतो भीत: पलायामि गच्छेयं नासुख सुखात्॥
en: Death is considered by all creatures as painful. Life is an acquisition difficult to make. Hence, I fly away in fear, I do not wish to pass from a state of weal to one of woe.

sa: महतो ह्येनसो मान्मोचयेदनुकीर्तितः। त्रिभिर्वपलब्धकामः कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः॥
en: Therefore, when recited, it purifies men from their sins. The Rishi Krishna Dvaipayana completed it in three years.

sa: ततःप्रभृति चाद्यापि यष्टेः क्षितिपसत्तमैः प्रवेशः क्रियते राजन्यथा तेन प्रवर्तितः॥
en: O king, from that day up to this day, all kings, following the example of Vasu, began to plant a bamboo-stick on the ground to worship Indra.

sa: अथ तेषूपविष्टेषु सर्वेष्वेव महात्मसु। नारदस्त्वथ देवर्षिराजगाम यदृच्छया॥
en: When (one day) those illustrious heroes so seated, there came to them the celestials Rishi Narada in course of his travels.

sa: निरुक्तमस्य यो वेद सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते। भरतानां यतश्चायमितिहासो महाद्भुतः॥
