en: He who knows the etymology of the name (Bharata is cleansed of all his sins. As this history of the Bharata race is wonderful.

sa: यदाश्रौषं कर्णमासाद्य मुक्तं वधाद्धीमं कुत्सयित्वा वचोभिः। धनुष्कोट्यातुद्य कर्णेन वीरं तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Karna, having got Bhima in his power, had allowed him to escape only with some contemptuous terms and having dragged him with the end of his bow.

sa: तासां व्युच्चरमाणानां कौमारात्सुभगे पतीन्। नाधर्मोऽभूद्वरारोहे स हि धर्मः पुराऽभवत्॥
en: O fortunate lady, O beautiful one, they had promiscuous intercourse form their maidenhood and they were not regarded sinful, for it was the custom of the age.

sa: यदाश्रौषं श्रान्तहये धनंजये मुक्त्वा हयान् पाययित्वोपवृत्तान्। पुनर्युक्त्वा वासुदेवं प्रयातं तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Vasudeva, finding the horses of Arjuna fatigued, unyoked them in the field of battle, gave them water to drink and re-yoking them, drove the chariot as before.

sa: यदाश्रौषमभिन्युं निहत्य हर्षान्मूढान्क्रोशतो धार्तराष्ट्रान्। क्रोधादुक्तं सैन्धवे चार्जुनेन तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that the blind Kauravas were shouting was with joy for killing Abhimanyu and that Arjuna had taken his celebrated vow about Saindhava.

sa: यदाश्रौषमसुराणां वधार्थे किरीटिनं यान्तममित्रकर्शनम्। कृतार्थे चाप्यागतं शक्रलोकात् तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that the chastiser of foes, Arjuna, had gone to the land of Indra to kill the Asuras and had come back successfully.

sa: सर्वे वर्णाः स्वधर्मस्थाः सदा चेदिषु मानद। न तेऽस्त्यविदितं किंचित्रिषु लोकेषु यद्भवेत्॥
en: They are all well-fed and fat. O reverencer of the celestials, the four castes are engaged in doing their respective duties in Chedi. Let nothing in the three worlds remain unknown to you.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच नाहमेतत् करिष्यामि जीवितार्थी कथंचन। ब्राह्मणस्यातिथैश्चैव स्वार्थे प्राणान् वियोजयन्॥
en: The Brahmana said : I can never do this in order to live. I can not cause the death of a Brahmana and a guest for saving my own life.

sa: देवयान्युवाच संसृष्टं ब्रह्मणा क्षत्रं क्षत्रेण ब्रह्म संहितम्। ऋषिश्चाप्यधिपुत्रश्च नाहुषाङ्ग वहस्व माम्॥
en: Devayani said : Brahmanas have already been mixed with Kshatriyas and Kshatriyas with Brahmanas. You are a son of a Rishi and a yourself a Rishi. Therefore, O son of Nahusha, marry me.

sa: न त्वेतदकुलीनासु नाधर्मिष्ठासु विद्यते। यद् ब्राह्मणार्थं विसृजेदात्मानमपि चात्मजम्॥
en: Even those that are lowly born and sinful refuse to do this; one should sacrifice himself and children for the sake of a Brahmana.

sa: आत्मनस्तु मया श्रेयो बोद्धव्यमिति रोचते। ब्रह्मवध्याऽऽत्मवध्या वा श्रेयानात्मवधो मम॥ ब्रह्मवध्या परं पापं निष्कृति त्र विद्यते। अबुद्धिपूर्वं कृत्वापि वमात्मवधो मम॥
en: I consider this precept best for me and I like to follow it. Between the death of a Brahmana and of my own, I would prefer the latter. To kill a Brahmana is a great sin, of which there is no expiation. It is best for me to sacrifice myself reluctantly instead of sacrificing a Brahmana reluctantly.

sa: स्ते मां यथा व्यभिचरन्ति नित्यम्। अप्यस्य पापस्य भवेदिहान्तः कं ब्रह्महत्या न दहेदपीन्द्रम्॥
en: These followers of Rudra (Asuras) want to make me a non-Brahmana by making me participate in their crimes of killing Brahmanas. The crime of killing a Brahmana even bums Indra. This crime has a terrible end."

sa: इत्येतानि समीक्ष्याहं कारणानि भृगूद्वह। अधर्मभयसंविग्नः शर्मिष्ठामुपजग्मिवान्॥
en: O son of Bhrigu, for these reason and being afraid of committing a sin, I went to Sharmishtha.

sa: समुत्पाट्यामृतं तत्र वैनतेयस्ततो बली। उत्पपात जवेनैव यन्त्रमन्मथ्य वीर्यवान्॥
en: The mighty son of Vinata, taking up the Ambrosia from the place where it was, rose on his wings, breaking the instrument into pieces.

sa: तयोश्चक्षूसि रजसा सुपर्णः सहसाऽऽवृणोत्। ताभ्यामदृष्टरूपोऽसौ सर्वतः समताडयत्॥
en: The great bird (Suparna) suddenly covered their eyes with dust and thus making them blind, he attacked them from all sides.

sa: दुःखानामागमो ब्राह्मण उवाच धिगिदं जीवितं लोके गतसारमनर्थकम्। दुःखमूलं पराधीनं भृशमप्रियभागि च॥
en: The Brahmana said: Fie on the life in this world which is hollow as the read. It is full of misery; it is a slave to others; it is based on great sorrow.

sa: बभञ्जतुस्तदा वृक्षाल्लताश्चाकर्षतुस्तदा। मत्ताविव च संरब्धौ वारणौ षष्टिहायनौ॥
en: Fighting like two large elephants mad with rage, they broke down the trees and tore off the creepers that grew around.

sa: निराबाधास्त्वयि हते मया राक्षसांसन। वनमेतच्चरिष्यन्ति पुरुषा वनचारिणः॥
en: O worst of Rakshasas, when you will be killed by me men frequenting this forest will live safely and without fear.

sa: ज्वलनार्कप्रभं घोरं छेदनं सोमहारिणाम्। घोररूपं तदत्यर्थं यन्त्रं देवैः सुनिर्मितम्॥
en: And that fearful instrument of fearful form, as blazing as the blazing sun, was skillfully created by the celestials to cut down the robbers of the Ambrosia.

sa: न हीयं स्ववशा बाला कामयत्यद्य मामिह। चोदितैषा ह्यनङ्गेन शरीरान्तरचारिणा॥
en: This girl is not in her own control in becoming lustful towards me. She has been moved by the god of love who pervades every living form.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु पृथया स विप्रो भार्यया सह। हृष्टः सम्पूजयामास तद्वाक्यममृतोपमम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed by Pritha (Kunti) the Brahmana and his wife became exceedingly glad and assented to those nectar like words (of Kunti).

sa: गुरोरुष्य सकाशे तु दशवर्षशतानि सः। अनुज्ञात: कचो गन्तुमियेष त्रिदशालयम्॥
en: Kacha, after having lived with his preceptor for full one thousand years, prepared to go to the land of the celestials with the permission of his preceptor.

sa: नायं प्रतिबलो भीरू राक्षसापसदो मम। सोढुं युधि परिस्पन्दमथवा सर्वराक्षसाः॥
en: O timid girl, this worst of Rakshasas is not a worthy antagonist of mine, nay all the Rakshasas can never with stand my great prowess in battle.

sa: स शीलयन् देवयानी कन्यां सम्प्राप्तयौवनाम्। पुष्पैः फलैः प्रेषणैश्च तोषयामास भारत॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, he gratified that maiden, Devayani, who was in her youth, with the presentations of flowers and fruits and serving her as an obedient servant.

sa: भीमार्जुनाभ्यां योधाभ्यामास्थितः कृष्णसारथिः। शुशुभे रथवर्योऽसौ दुर्जयः सर्वधन्विभिः॥
en: That celestials car, invincible to all warriors, ridden by the heroes, Bhima and Arjuna, and driven by Krishna, looked exceedingly beautiful.

sa: अहं कामगमा वीर रक्षोबलसमन्विता। आरुहेमां मम श्रोणि नेष्यामि त्वां विहायसा॥
en: O hero, endued as I am with the prowess of Rakshasas, I am capable of going anywhere at will. Get upon my hips; I shall carry you through the sky.

sa: अर्थों द्वावपि निष्पन्नौ युधिष्ठिर भविष्यतः। प्रतीकारश्च वासस्य धर्मश्च चरितो महान्॥
en: O Yudhisthira, two objects will be gained by this act, one is the requital of the Brahmana's services (to us) and the other is the acquisition of great religious merit.

sa: यथा त्विदं न विन्देयुनरा नगरवासिनः। तथायं ब्राह्मणो वाच्यः परिग्राह्यश्च यत्नतः॥
en: But tell the Brahmana that he must not to any thing by which the people of this town may know all about it. You must carefully make him promise it.

sa: साहं त्वामभिसम्प्रेक्ष्य देवगर्भसमप्रभम्। नान्यं भर्तारमिच्छामि सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: I tell you truly that seeing you as effulgent as a celestial, I do not desire anybody else to be my husband except you.

sa: इति मद्वचनाद्रामो वक्तव्यो मम संग्रहः॥ निरीक्ष्य माद्य गच्छ त्वमृतुकालातिवर्तिनीम्।
en: Do you, O Lakşmaņa, communicate it in short to Rāma, in my name. Do you go now and behold the signs of pregnancy are manifest in me.

sa: त्वमप्यन्तर्जलचरः कच्छपः संभविष्यसि। एवमन्योन्यशापात्तौ सुप्रतीकविभावसू॥
en: “You will become an aquatic tortoise." Thus being cursed by each other Supratika and Vibhavasu,

sa: तयोर्जन्मान्तरे वैरं संप्रवक्ष्याम्यशेषतः। तन्मे तत्त्वं निबोधत्स्व यत्प्रमाणौ च तावुभौ॥
en: I shall speak to you in detail their hostility in the former life. Hear from me the true story, the proof of which is their presence here.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच सनामायां सनामा स कन्यायां द्विजसत्तमः। अपत्यं वीर्यसंपन्नं वीर्यवाञ्जनयिष्यति॥
en: Brahma said: The best of Brahmanas, the greatly powerful (Jaratkaru) will beget a greatly powerful son on his wife who will bear the same name as his.

sa: न जातु कामः कामानामुपभोगेन शाम्यति। हविषा कृष्णवर्मेव भूय एवाभिवर्धते॥
en: "One's desires are never satiated with enjoyments. On On the the other hand, with indulgence they flame up like the sacrificial fire with ghee poured into it.

sa: तमुचाच खगश्रेष्ठं तत्र रौहिणपादपः। अतिप्रवृद्धः सुमहानापतन्तं मनोजवम्॥
en: The great tree spoke to the best of the birds, who was flying away with the speed of the mind, saying,

sa: कार्यवन्तो गृहानेत्य शत्रुतो नार्हणां वयम्। प्रतिगृह्णीम तद् विद्धि एतन्नः शाश्वतं व्रतम्॥
en: O king, know that this is our eternal vow that having entered the house of the enemy for the purpose of accomplishing an object, we do not accept the worship offered by him.

sa: तानुवाच जरासंधः सत्यसंधो नराधिपः। बिगर्हमाणः कौरव्य वेषग्रहणवैकृतान्। न स्नातकव्रता विप्रा बहिर्माल्यानुलेपनाः॥ भवन्तीति नृलोकेऽस्मिन् विदितं मम सर्वशः। के यूयं पुष्पवन्तश्च भुजाकृतलक्षणैः॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, the firmly truthful king Jarasandha spoke to them thus, “It is wellknown to me that no where in the whole world the Brahmanas engaged in observing the Snataka vows ever adorn themselves with garlands or with fragrant paste. Who are you then, thus adorned with flowers and with hands that bear the marks of the bow-string?

sa: आचार्यवेतनं किंचिद्धृदि यद् वर्तते मम। कृतास्त्रैस्तत् प्रदेयं स्यात् तदृतं वदतानघाः। सोऽर्जुनप्रमुखैरुक्तस्तथास्त्विति गुरुस्तदा॥
en: O sinless eyes, when you will be all experts in arms, you must give me as the preceptorial fee that which I cherish in my heart.” Arjuna and others said to the preceptor, "Be it so."

sa: र्यः सर्वविद्यासु विनीतबुद्धिः। वेदानधीत्य तपसाऽऽयोज्य देह दिवं समायात् पुरुषो वीतमोहः॥
en: He who, having acquired great wealth performs sacrifices, who, having acquired all kinds of learning, remains humble, who, having studied the entire Vedas, devotes himself to asceticism, goes to heaven.

sa: जरत्कारुर्यदा भार्यामिच्छेद्वरयितुं प्रभुः। शीघ्रमेत्य तदाख्येयं तन्नः श्रेयो भविष्यति॥
en: "When the Lord Jaratkaru will ask for a wife, come immediately and inform me of it. The weal of our race depends upon it.”

sa: अस्मानयं सुविश्वस्तान् वेत्ति पापः पुरोचनः। वञ्चितोऽयं नृशंसात्मा कालं मन्ये पलायने॥
en: Yudhisthira said: The cruel hearted and sinful Purochana thinks us very trustful and he has thus been well deceived. I think (therefore) that the time for our escape has come.

sa: तथैव च महाभागः सोऽपश्यत् संशितव्रतौ। याजोपयाजौ ब्रह्मर्षी शाम्यन्तौ परमेष्ठिनौ॥
en: There saw that illustrious king two (Brahmanas) named Yaja and Upayaja, both were of rigid vows, both were self controlled and both belonged to the highest order.

sa: स तथेति प्रतिश्रुत्य खनको यत्नमास्थितः। परिखामुत्किरन्नाम चकार च महाबिलम्॥
en: The miner promised to do it by saying "Be it so"; and he began with care the work of excavation and he (soon) made a subterranean passage.

sa: सेयमापदनुप्राप्ता क्षत्ता यां दृष्टवान् पुरा। पुरोचनस्याविदितानस्मांस्त्वं प्रतिमोचय॥
en: The danger that Kshatta (Vidura) saw beforehand is now at our door, Save us from this without the knowledge of Purochana.

sa: अर्बुदः शक्रवापी च पन्नगौ शत्रुतापनौ। स्वस्तिकस्यालयश्चात्र मणिनागस्य चोत्तमः॥
en: Here were the abodes of the chastisers of foes, the Nagas, Arbuda, Chakrapani and Swastika, and also that of the excellent Naga, called Mani.

sa: परिक्षितो नरेन्द्रस्य विद्धो यन्नष्टवान्मृगः। दूरं चापहृतस्तेन मृगेण स महीपतिः॥
en: The deer, that the king of men, Parikshit wounded, was soon lost out of his sight and the king went in pursuit it far into the forest.

sa: किंचिच्च विदुरेणोक्तो म्लेच्छवाचासि पाण्डव। त्वया च तत् तथेत्युक्तमेतद् विश्वासकारणम्॥
en: O Pandavas, something was told to you by Vidura in the Mlecha language and you too replied in that language. I tell you this as a credential."

sa: वहास्मानपरं द्वीपं सुरम्यं विमलोदकम्। त्वं हि देशान्बहूनम्यान्व्रजन्पश्यसि खेचर॥
en: “Take us to some other beautiful islands with pure water. O bird, you must have seen many beautiful countries when coursing through the sky."

sa: ब्राह्यं संधारयंस्तेजो हुताहुतिरिवानलः। समेत्य स दहत्याजौ क्षात्रधर्मपुरस्सरः॥
en: Like blazing fire fed with ghee, Drona, possessing both the Brahma inight and the Kshatriya might consumes every antagonist in battle.

sa: पुष्पवेष्टितशाखाग्रैर्गन्धवद्भिर्मनोहरैः। निगूढा इव लोध्राणां वनैः कामिजनप्रियैः॥
en: They are concealed by the forest of charming and fragrant Lodhra trees with their branches covered with flowers.

sa: मेघानाज्ञापयामास वर्षध्वममृतं शुभम्। ते मेघामुमुचुस्तोयं प्रभूतं विधुदुज्ज्वलाः॥
en: He commanded the clouds saying. “Pour down your life-giving and beneficial showers." Those clouds, luminous with lightning, then poured abundant water.

sa: याजस्तु हवनस्यान्ते देवीमाज्ञापयत् तदा। प्रेहि मां राज्ञि पृषति मिथुनं त्वामुपस्थितम्॥
en: Yaja then poured libations of ghee on the sacrificial fire and ordered the queen thus, “O daughter-in-law of Prishata, come here a son and a daughter have come for you.

sa: नमुचिघ्न नमस्तेऽस्तु सहस्राक्ष शचीपते। सर्पाणां सूर्यतप्तानां वारिणा त्वं प्लवो भव॥
en: O slayer of Namuchi, I bow to thee, O god of thousand eyes, O Lord of Sachi, save my sons, oppressed by the rays of the sun by your showers.

sa: प्रतर्दन उवाच तांस्ते ददानि मा प्रपत प्रपातं ये मे लोकास्तव ते वै भवन्तु। स्तानाक्रम क्षिप्रमपेतमोहः॥
en: Pratardana said : I give to you all of them. Therefore, though falling, you must not fall. Let all the regions for me to enjoy be yours, whether they may be in heaven or in the firmament. Take them soon and let your sorrow cease.

sa: देवयान्युवाच दत्तां वहस्व तन्मा त्वं पित्रा राजन् वृतो मया। अयाचतो भयं नास्ति दत्तां च प्रतिगृह्णतः॥
en: Devayani said : You are chosen by me. O king it is then settled that you will accept me if my father bestows you on me. You need not fear in accept my humble self, if bestowed on you. You have not asked for me.

sa: मेरुं वा खादितुं शक्ता किं पुनस्त्व बालकम्। गृहसम्पूजनात् तुष्ट्या मया प्रत्यर्पितस्तव॥
en: I can swallow (even) the mountain of Meru, what I speak of your child. I am gratified with the worship that I receive in your house; therefore the child is returned to you,

sa: एवमुक्तास्तदा पौराः कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्। आशीभिश्चाभिनन्द्यैताञ्जग्मुर्नगरमेव हि॥
en: Having been thus addressed, the citizens walked round the Pandavas and offered them their blessings. They then returned to the city.

sa: एवमुक्ता ततः कन्या देवं वरदमब्रवीत्। एकमिच्छाम्यहं देव त्वत्प्रसादात् पतिं प्रभो॥
en: Having been thus addressed the maiden thus spoke to the deity who gave her the boon, "O deity, O lord, I desire to have only one husband through your grace.”

sa: सर्वा मातृस्तथाऽऽपृच्छ्य कृत्वा चैव प्रदक्षिणम्। सर्वाः प्रकृतयश्चैव प्रययुर्वारणावतम्॥
en: Taking leave of all the mothers (elderly ladies), walking round them respectfully and bidding farewell to the citizens, they (the Pandavas) started for Varanavata.

sa: नार्हामि विषये राज्ञो वसन्ती पुत्रगृद्धिनः। बालं पुत्रमिमं हन्तुं धार्मिकस्य महात्मनः॥
en: “I live in the kingdom of the king who is so eager to get a son. I should not therefore, kill the child so such a virtuous and illustrious king.

sa: ततः सा राक्षसी राजन् विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचना। न शशाक समुद्वोढुं वज्रसारमयं शिशुम्॥
en: O king, the Rakshasas woman, with her cyes wide opened in wonder, found herself unable to carry that child who had a body as hard and strong as the thunderbolt.

sa: वज्रमुत्सृज्य वृत्राय श्रान्तेऽथ त्रिदिवेश्वरे। शतं वर्षसहस्राणि येनेन्द्रत्वं प्रशासितम्॥
en: When Indra, the king of the celestials, was assailed with thunderbolt by the Asura Větra, Nahuşa governed his kingdom for a hundred thousand years.

sa: पातालज्वलनावासमसुराणां तथालयम्। भयंकराणां सत्त्वानां पयसो निधिमव्ययम्॥
en: The abode of subterranean fire, the home of the Asuras and many fearful creatures, the reservoir of waters.

sa: अथ काले महाप्राज्ञ यथासमयमागते। प्रजायेतामुभे राजञ्छरीरशकले तदा॥
en: O greatly wise (king), sometime after when the (proper) season came, each of the two queens brought forth two fragmentary bodies.

sa: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य मित्रावरुणसंभवः। वसिष्ठस्तेजसा युक्तो जज्ञे इक्ष्वाकुदैवतम्॥
en: There upon after some time from the energies of both Mitra and Varuņa sprang up the effulgent Vasistha-the priest of Iksvākus.

sa: अथ काक्षीवतः पुत्रं गौतमस्य महात्मनः। शुश्राव तपसि श्रान्तमुदारं चण्डकौशिकम्॥ यदृच्छयाऽऽगतं तं तु वृक्षमूलमुपाश्रितम्। पत्नीभ्यां सहितो राजा सर्वरत्नैरतोषयत्॥
en: He heard one day that the illustrious Chandakaushika, the son of Kakshivana of the Goutama race, having been tired of ascetic penances, have come to his city in his wandering at pleasure, and that he sat under a tree. The king with his wives gratified the Rishi with presents of Jewels.

sa: अभ्यसूयन्ति सततं परस्परममित्रवत्। ततोऽहं तप आतिष्ठं नैतान्पश्येयमित्युत॥
en: They are jealous of one another like great enemies. I am, therefore, engaged in penances. I shall not even see them.

sa: कृष्ण उवाच शृणु राजञ्जरासंधो यद्वीर्यो यत्पराक्रमः। यथा चोपेक्षितोऽस्माभिबहुशः कृतविप्रियः॥
en: Krishna said O king, hear who is Jarasandha, what is his might and prowess, and why he has been spared by us, though he repeatedly offended us.

sa: अथाम्बराद्भयजननाः प्रपेदिरे सपादपा बहुविधमेघरूपिणः। महाद्रयः परिगलिताग्रसानवः परस्परं द्रुतमभिहत्य सस्वनाः॥
en: And those fearful mountains, with their forests and flat tops, like masses of clouds, fell from the sky, collided with one another and produced a tremendous roar.

sa: सोऽभिगम्य ततः शीघ्रं नरेन्द्रं कुरुवर्धनम्। विवेश भवनं राज्ञः पूर्वं द्वास्थैर्निवेदितः॥
en: Going (to Hastinapur) he soon came to the king, the head of the Kuru race. He entered the king's palace, having first sent the notice of his arrival through gate-keeper.

sa: ययातिरुवाच क्रुद्धादाशीविषात् सर्पाज्ज्वलनात् सर्वतोमुखात्। दुराधर्षतरो विप्रो ज्ञेयः पुंसा विजानता॥
en: Yayati said : The wise men know that a Brahmana is to be avoided than an angry and virulently poisonous snake, or a blazing and flaming fire.

sa: ततो वैरविनिर्बन्धः कृतो राहुमुखेन वै। शाश्वतश्चन्द्रसूर्याभ्यां ग्रसत्यद्यापि चैव तौ॥
en: From that day a great enmity was created between the head of Rahu and Chandra and Surya. To this day it swallows Chandra and Surya (causing eclipses.)

sa: अगस्त्यस्य धनुर्वेद शिष्यों मम गुरुः पुरा। अग्निवेश इति ख्यातस्तस्य शिष्योऽस्मि भारत॥ तीर्थात् तीर्थं गमयितुमहमेतत् समुद्यतः। तपसा यन्मया प्राप्तममोघमशनिप्रभम्॥ अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरो नाम यद् दहेत् पृथिवीमपि। ददता गुरुणा चोक्तं न मनुष्येष्विदं त्वया॥ भारद्वाज विमोक्तव्यमल्पवीर्येष्वपि प्रभो। त्वया प्राप्तमिदं वीर दिव्यं नान्योऽर्हति त्विदम्॥ समयस्तु त्वया रक्ष्यो मुनिसृष्टो विशाम्पते। आचार्यदक्षिणां देहि ज्ञातिग्रामस्य पश्यतः॥
en: In the time of yore Agastya had a disciple in the science of arms. Who was known as Agnivesha. He was my preceptor and I was his disciple. O descendant of Bharata, I obtained from him by asceticism a weapon, known by the name of Brahmashira, which can never be futile and which is like thunder itself and capable of consuming the whole earth. That weapon from what I have done may now descend from disciple to disciple. Giving it to me, my preceptor said, “O son of Bharadvaja, do not hurl this weapon against any human being and against one who possess but little energy." O hero, (Arjuna), you have obtained that celestial weapon (from me); none else deserves it. But O Vishampata, obey the command of that best of Rishis (Agnivesha). Now give your preceptor's Dakshina before all your relatives an

sa: ततः पिबत्सु तत्कालं देवेष्वमृतमीप्सितम्। राहुविबुधरूपेण दानवः प्रापिबत्तदा॥
en: When the celestials were drinking the much longed-for Ambrosia, a Danava, named Rahu, drank it in the guise of a celestial.

sa: तेजसस्तपसश्चैव कोपस्य च महात्मनः। त्वमप्युद्विजसे यस्य नोद्विजेयमहं कथम्॥
en: The energy, the asceticism and the wrath of that illustrious man have made even you anxious. Why should I not be afraid of him?

sa: दुपद उवाच अनार्शयमिदं ब्रह्मन् विक्रान्तेषु महात्मसु। प्रीये त्वयाहं त्वत्तश्च प्रीतिमिच्छामि शाश्वतीम्॥
en: Drupada said : O Brahmana, this is not (at all) wonderful to the man of noble soul and great prowess. I am pleased with you and I desire to give you everlasting pleasure.

sa: सौतिरुवाच अथावरणमुग्यानि नानाप्रहरणानि च। प्रगृह्याभ्यद्रवन्देवान्सहिता दैत्यदानवाः॥
en: Sauti said : Then the Daityas and Danavas, in best armours and with various weapons, pursued the celestials.

sa: प्राप्ते च दिवसे तस्मिन्सप्तमे द्विजसत्तमः। काश्यपोऽभ्यागमद्विद्वांस्तं राजानं चिकित्सितुम्॥
en: When the seventh day came, the best of Brahmanas, Kashyapa, was coming with the intention of treating the king, (if bitten by the snake).

sa: भये तु समतिक्रान्ते जरासंधे समुद्यते। मन्त्रोऽयं मन्त्रितो राजन् कुलैरष्टादशावरैः॥
en: O king, though the immediate cause of our fear was thus removed, yet Jarasandha (Kansa's father-in-law) took up arms. We eighteen branches of the Yadavas consulted together;

sa: तं ददर्श स नागेन्द्रस्तक्षकः काश्यपं पथि। गच्छन्तमेकमनसं द्विजो भूत्वा वयोतिगः॥
en: The king of the snakes, Takshaka, saw on the way, Kashyapa, going with the intention of curing the king. He appeared before him in the form of an old Brahmana.

sa: श्रेष्ठ्यं प्राप्तः स तस्यासीदतीवापनयो महान्। भोजराजन्यवृद्धैश्च पीड्यमानैर्दुरात्मना॥
en: By his such acts he earned a very bad repute. The wicked wretch persecuted the old chiefs of the Bhoja race.

sa: न कुलं स बलं राजन्नभ्यजानात् तथाऽऽत्मनः। एश्यमानो यशो दीप्तं जरासंधमुपस्थितः॥
en: O king, without knowing his own strength and the dignity of the race to which he belongs, he (Bhishmaka) has placed himself under Jarasandha's shelter only seeing his blazing fame.

sa: शीघ्रमभ्यस्यतो बाणान् संदधानस्य चानिशम्। नान्तरं ददृशे किंचिन् कौन्तेयस्य यशस्विनः॥
en: They, that saw the son of Kunti (at that time), could not mark any interval between his fixing the arrows on the bowstring and letting them off.

sa: प्रियमेव परीप्सन्ते केचिदात्मनि यद्धितम्। एवमप्रायाश्च दृश्यन्ते जनवादाः प्रयोजने॥
en: Some again consider that which is beneficial to them as the fittest thing to be adopted, Men are seen to advice thus in business.

sa: समर्थोऽसि महाबाहो सर्वे ते वशगा वयम्। अचिरात् त्वं महाराज राजसूयमवाप्स्यसि॥
en: O mighty armed hero, O great king, you are quite capable of performing this sacrifice. We are all obedient to you. You will soon be able to perform the Rajasuya.

sa: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा साधुकारो महानभूत्। ऋषीणामुग्रतपसां यमुनातीरवासिनाम्॥
en: Hearing his words, the sages of fierce austerities inhabiting the banks of the Yamunā, broke out into a peal of plandits.

sa: बहवः पार्थिवा राजन्नातिक्रान्ता महाबलाः। कार्यस्य गौरवं मत्वा प्रतिज्ञां नाभ्यरोचयन्॥
en: Many kings wielding great power have passed away who, having regard to the (possible) gravity of the undertaking, could not bring themselves to promise anything before hand.

sa: दुपदस्य शरा घोरा विचेरुः सर्वतो दिशम्। ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च मृदङ्गाश्च सहस्रशः॥ प्रावाद्यन्त महाराज पाञ्चालानां निवेशने। सिंहनादश्च संजज्ञे पाञ्चालानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: The fearful arrows of Drupada fell on all sides and thousands of conches, trumpets and drums began to be sounded by the Panchalas in their houses. O great king, a terrible roar, like that of the lion, rose from the mighty Panchalas. The great sound of the twang of their bow-strings seemed to rend the very sky.

sa: कासि कस्यासि रम्भोस किमर्थं चेह तिष्ठसि। कथं च निर्जनेऽरण्ये चरस्येका शुचिस्मिते॥
en: The Samvarana said : O lady of tapering things, who and whose are you? Why are you staying here? O lady of sweet smiles, why do you wander alone in these solitary woods?

sa: ततः सर्वस्य रङ्गस्य हाहाकारो महानभूत्। साधुवादानुसम्बद्धः सूर्यश्चास्तमुपागमत्॥
en: Thereupon there arose a loud cheer among all the spectators, approving of Duryodhana's speech. At this time the sun went down.

sa: यस्य वा मनुजस्येदं न क्षान्तं मद्विचेष्टितम्। रथमारुह्य पद्भ्यां स विनामयतु कार्मुकम्॥
en: If there is any one to whom all that I have done to him (Karna) has became intolerable, let him ascend his car and bend his bow with the help of his feet."

sa: राजापि यजते यज्ञमस्याश्रमसमीपतः। अश्वमेधं महायज्ञं तं वसिष्ठोऽप्यपालयत्॥
en: Saudása engaged in celebrating a mighty horse-sacrifice in the vicinity of this hermitage. Vasiștha officiated as a priest at that sacrifice.

sa: एताः सहस्रशश्चान्या नृत्यगीतविशारदाः। उपतिष्ठन्ति धनदं गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणाः॥
en: These and a thousand other Apsaras and Gandharvas, all great experts in music and dance, wait upon the lord of wealth.

sa: ततः पादाववच्छाद्य पटान्तेन ससमम्भ्रमः। पुत्रेति परिपूर्णार्थमब्रवीत् रथसारथिः॥
en: The charioteer (Adhiratha) hurriedly covered his feet with the end of his sheet and addressed the successful Karna as his son.

sa: असंख्येयानि कर्माणि यान्यस्य रघुनन्दन। इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवे यद्वृत्तं तच्छृणुष्व मे॥
en: O descendant of Raghu, Lavaņa has accomplished many works by this dart; among them, hear, what Māndhāta, born in the race of Iksawaku, did.

sa: ततस्तु राजनममित्रतापनं समीक्ष्य ते तस्य नृपस्य मन्त्रिणः। सुवर्णवर्माणमुपेत्य काशिपं वपुष्टमार्थं वरयांप्रचक्रमुः॥
en: Seeing that the young king could now keep his enemies in check, his ministers, went to Suvarnavarmana, the king of Kashi and asked him to give his daughter, Vapushtama in marriage with him.

sa: ततो विदित्वा पार्थस्त्वां प्रतियोत्स्यति वा न वा। वृथाकुलसमाचारैर्न युध्यन्ते नृपात्मजाः॥
en: Knowing this, Partha will fight with you, or he will not fight (as he will think proper.) The sons of kings never fight a duel with men of inferior lineage.

sa: गङ्गायास्तु परे पारे वाल्मीकेस्तु महात्मनः॥ आश्रमो दिव्यसंकाशस्तमसातीरमाश्रितः।
en: There is a picturesque hermitage of the highsouled Vālmīki situate on the Tamasā on the other side of the river Gangā.

sa: किंद्रव्यास्ताः सभा ब्रह्मन् किंविस्ताराः किमायताः। पितामहं च के तस्यां सभायां पर्युपासते॥
en: O Brahmana, which Sabha (assembly-hall) is made of what articles? What is the area of each, and what is the length and breadth of each? Who waits upon the Grandsire in his Sabha?

sa: वसिष्ठेनाभ्यनुज्ञातस्तस्मिन्नेव धराधरे। सोऽकामयत राजर्षिविहर्तुं सह भार्यया॥
en: The royal sage (Samvarana) with the permission of Vasishtha desired to sport with his wife on that mountain.

sa: पुष्टायतशिरोग्रीवां विस्मितः सोऽभिवीक्ष्य ताम्। अभिनन्द्य स तां राजा नन्दिनी गाधिनन्दनः॥
en: O prince, that king, the son of Gadhi, was exceedingly gratified with all that he saw and very much praising (the cow) Nandini he thus spoke to the Rishi (Vasishtha),

sa: तस्य मे युद्धकामस्य द्वन्द्वयुद्धं प्रदीयताम्। शस्त्वं सर्वभूतानां न मे जीवन्गमिष्यसि॥
en: I wish now to fight with you-do you enter into a dual conflict. You are the enemy of all animals. You shall not be able to survive at my hands.

sa: कत्त्वित् सूत्राणि सर्वाणि गृह्णासि भरतर्षभ। हस्तिसूत्राश्वसूत्राणि रथसूत्राणि वा विभो॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, O lord do you follow all the Sutras (aphorisms) of the sages, especially those in respect of elephants, horses and chariots.

sa: इमं तु भूय इच्छामि कुरूणां वंशमादितः। कथ्यमानं त्वया विप्र विप्रर्षिगणसंनिधौ॥
en: Now I desire to hear the accounts of the births of the kings of the Kuru race from the beginning. Therefore, O Brahmana, narrate them before all these Brahmana Rishis.

sa: चरन्दीक्षां महातेजा दुश्चरामकृतात्मभिः। वायुभक्षो निराहारः शुष्यन्ननिमिषो मुनिः॥
en: He practised difficult austere penances; and feeding on air, remaining in fast and renouncing sleep forever, he roamed (over the world.)

sa: कच्चिदेषा च ते बुद्धिर्वृत्तिरेषा च तेऽनघ। आयुष्या च यशस्या च धर्मकामार्थदर्शिनी॥
en: O sinless one, are your disposition and practice such as I have described, and such as always lengthen the period of life spread fame and help the cause of Dharma, Artha and Kama?

sa: अद्य मदाहुनिष्क्रान्तः शरो वज्रनिभाननः। प्रवेक्ष्यते ते हृदयं पद्ममंशुरिवार्कजः॥
en: As the rays of the sun enter into lotus so shall arrows, hard as lightning, discharged by my hands, shall enter into your heart.

sa: तस्मादहमुपश्रुत्य प्रवक्ष्यामि यथातथम्। इदमास्तीकमाख्यानं तुभ्यं शौनक पृच्छते॥
en: I was present at the time, O Shaunaka, As you ask me, I shall recite it exactly as I heard it.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवो राजाऽऽसीत् पृथिवीपतिः। महाभिष इति ख्यातः सत्यवाक् सत्यविक्रमः॥ सोऽश्वमेधसहस्रेण राजसूयशतेन च। तोषयामास देवेशं स्वर्ग लेभे ततः प्रभुः॥
en: Vaishampayana said: There was bom a king in the race of Ikshvaku and he was known by the name of Mahabhisha. He, a man, a lord of the world, was truthful and was truly powerful. By performing one thousand Ashvamedha and one hundred Rajasuya sacrifices, he pleased the lord of the celestials. Then he ascended to heaven.

sa: लब्धसंज्ञो रुस्चायात्तदाचख्यौ पितुस्तदा। पिता चास्य तदाख्यानं पृष्टः सर्वं न्यवेदयत्॥
en: Regaining his senses, he came home and asked his father (to relate the history) and his father related to him the story. End of Pau loma Parva

sa: कच्चिन्नगरगुप्त्यर्थं ग्रामा नगरवत् कृताः। ग्रामवच्च कृताः प्रान्तास्ते च सर्वे त्वदर्पणाः॥
en: Have the villages been made (by you) like towns and the outskirts of towns like villages for the protection of your city? Are they all under your supervision and away?

sa: वरदास्तु महाबाहो सर्व एव समागताः। विजयाकाङ्क्षिणस्तुभ्यममोघं दर्शनं हि नः॥
en: O you having long arms, all those who can confer boons have arrived here; they all wish for your victory; seeing us does not go without fruits.

sa: सोऽपध्यातो भगवता ब्रह्मणा तु महाभिषः। उक्तश्च जातो मत्र्येषु पुनर्लोकानवाप्स्यसि॥
en: For this (ude act), Mahabhisha was cursed by Brahma . He said, "You will be born on earth and you shall then again attain to these regions."

sa: अपगच्छ पथोऽस्माकमित्येवं पार्थिवोऽब्रवीत्। तथा ऋषिरुवाचैनं सान्त्वयश्लक्ष्णया गिरा॥
en: The king said, Stand out of our way." Thereupon the Rishi spoke thus in a conciliatory manner and in sweet words,

sa: ततो द्वादशमे वर्षे शत्रुघ्नो रामपालिताम्। अयोध्यां चकमे गन्तुमल्पभृत्यबलानुगः॥
en: There upon on the completion of the twelfth year, Satrughna, with few servants, soldiers and followers, desired to proceed to Ayodhyā protected by Rama.

sa: वेदवेदाङ्गविन्नाम सर्वभूताभयप्रदः। अहिंसा सत्यवचनं क्षमा चेति विनिश्चितम्॥
en: Learned in the Vedas and the Vedangas and an inspirer of confidence in all creatures, kind to all, truthful and forgiving.

sa: एतत्सोमवचः श्रुत्वा तथास्विति दिवौकसः। प्रत्यूचुः सहिताः सर्वे ताराधिपमपूजयन्॥
en: Having heard these words of Soma, the celestials said, “Be it so.” They then all worshipped and praised the lord of the stars (Soma).

sa: तयोर्विवदतोरेवं समीपमुपचक्रमे। ऋषिरुग्रतपाः पार्थ विश्वामित्रः प्रतापवान्॥
en: O Partha, the Rishi of severe ascetic penances, the powerful Vishvamitra, came there where they were both quarrelling.

sa: सर्वेषामेव शत्रूणां चतुर्थांशं नयिष्यति। दिनार्धेन महाबाहुः प्रेतराजपुरं प्रति॥
en: The mighty-armed hero, within the course of half a day, will send the one-fourth part of the foes, to the land of the dead.

sa: कच्चिद् व्यसनिनं शत्रु निशम्य भरतर्षभ। अभियासि जवेनैव समीक्ष्य त्रिविधं बलम्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, do you reflecting well upon the three kinds of force, (at once) march, against your enemy when you hear that he is in distress?

sa: कच्चिद् भयादुपगतं क्षीणं वा रिपुमागतम्। युद्धे वा विजितं पार्थ पुत्रवत् परिरक्षसि॥
en: O son of Pritha, do you cherish as your sons the enemy who having been vanquished in battle, comes to you from fear, who has become weak and who has sought your protection?

sa: गच्छामुष्मिन् वनोद्देशे ब्राह्मणो मां प्रतीक्षते। अन्नार्थी तं त्वमन्नेन समांसेनोपपादय॥
en: Go at once to the forest where a Brahmana is waiting for me in the hope of getting food. Go and entertain him with food and meat.

sa: मातुश्चाप्यपराधाद्वै भ्रातृणां ते महद्भयम्। कृतोऽत्र परिहारश्च पूर्वमेव भुजंगम॥
en: (And I know also) their great danger owing to their offence against their mother. O snake, a remedy has been already provided by me.

sa: ततो रङ्गाङ्गणगतो द्रोणो वचनमब्रवीत्। निवार्य वादिगणं महामेघनिभस्वनम्॥
en: Then Drona entered the arena and sopping the musicians spoke thus in a voice deep as the roars of the clouds.

sa: कच्चिनैको बहूनान् सर्वशः साम्परायिकान्। अनुशास्ति यथाकामं कामात्मा शासनातिगः॥
en: Surely in your kingdom) a man who is beyond all control does not out of desire rule at pleasure over things pertaining military affairs.

sa: ततः क्षुब्धार्णवनिभं रङ्गमालोक्य बुद्धिमान्। भारद्वाजः प्रियं पुत्रमश्वत्थामानमब्रवीत्॥
en: On seeing the place become like a troubled ocean, the intelligent son of Bharadvaja, (Drona) spoke to his dear son Ashvathama.

sa: सोऽभिवाद्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं रथमारुह्य सुप्रभम्। अयोध्यामगमत्तूर्णं राघवोत्सुकदर्शनः॥
en: He was greatly anxious to behold Rāma and saluting the foremost of Munis he speedily preceded to Ayodhyā.

sa: संदिष्टौ मुनिना तेन तावुभौ मैथिलीसुतौ। तथैव करवावेति निर्जग्मतुररिंदमौ॥
en: Being thus commanded by the ascetic, Janakis' son, Lava and Kusa, the slayers of enemies, issued out there from saying. So we shall do."

sa: गतायुरेषा कृपणा गन्धर्वाप्सरसोः तस्माच्छोके मनस्तात मा कृथास्त्वं कथंचन॥
en: This poor child of the Gandharva and the Apsara has her days run out; therefore, O child, do not give yourself up to grief.

sa: यदि दत्तं तपस्तप्तं गुरवो वा मया यदि। सम्यगाराधितास्तेन संजीवतु मम प्रिया॥
en: If ever I have bestowed charity, if ever I have observed penances, if ever I have showed respect to my superiors, let the merits of these acts restore to life my beloved one.

sa: किं नु मे सुकृतं भूयाद्भर्तुरुत्थापनं न वा। दुःखशीलो हि धर्मात्मा कथं नास्यपराध्नुयाम्॥
en: (She thought) “What shall I do now? Shall I wake my husband or shall I not? He leads a hard life and he is virtuous. How can I act so that I may not offend him.

sa: सहसा चुक्रुशुश्चान्ये नराः शतसहस्रशः। विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयनाः साधु साध्विति भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, some hundreds and thousands of men, their eyes expanded with wonder, all at once cried out “Well done! Well done!"

sa: ममापचाराद्वालोऽसौ ब्राह्मणस्यैकपुत्रकः। अप्राप्तकालः कालेन नीतो वैवस्वतक्षयम्॥
en: It is for my iniquitous conduct that this only son of the Brāhmaṇa has met with untimely death.

sa: ते स्म लक्ष्याणि बिभिदुर्बाणैर्नामाङ्कशोभितैः। विविधैर्लाघवोत्सृष्टैरुह्यन्तो वाजिभिर्दुतम्॥
en: Riding swift horses and managing them dextrously, the princess hit marks with arrows engraved with their respective names.

sa: पाण्डवो यादवश्रेष्ठ कृष्णं कमललोचनम्। गम्यतामित्यनुज्ञाप्य धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: The Pandava Dharamraja Yudhishthira then gave permission to the best of Yadava race, the lotus-eyed Krishna to go be saying "Go".

sa: संप्रयोगो भवेन्नायं मम मोघस्त्वया द्विज। ज्ञातीनां हितमिच्छन्ती भगवंस्त्वां प्रसादये॥
en: Moved by the desire of doing good to my race, so that my connection with you be fruitful, O Brahmana, I entreat you not to go away.

sa: ततः शुक्लाम्बरधरः शुक्लयज्ञोपवीतवान्। शुक्लकेशः सितश्मश्रुः शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनः॥ रङ्गमध्यं तदाऽऽचार्यः सपुत्रः प्रविवेश ह। नभो जलधरैर्हीनं साङ्गारक इवांशुमान्॥
en: Then the preceptor, clad in white attire, with white sacred thread, white locks, white bread, white garlands and white sandal-paste besmeared over his body, entered the arena with his son. It appeared as if the moon accompanied (the planet) Mars appeared in an unclouded sky.

sa: यस्तु राजन्कृपो नाम ब्रह्मर्षिरभवक्षितौ। रुद्राणां तु गणाद्विद्धि संभूतमतिपौरुषम्॥
en: O king, that Brahmana Rishi, who was known in the world as Kripa, was the embodiment of all manliness, was born of the Rudraganas.

sa: सौतिरुवाच इत्युक्तः प्रत्युवाचेदं कदूपुत्राननुस्मरन्। स्मृत्वा चैवोपधिकृतं मातुर्दास्यनिमित्ततः॥
en: Sauti said : Being thus addressed, Garuda recollecting the sons of Kadru and the slavery of his mother by deception said,

sa: अप्यस्ति गर्भः सुभगे तस्मात्ते मुनिसत्तमात्। न चेच्छाम्यफलं तस्य दारकर्म मनीषिणः॥
en: O Fortunate one, are you quick, with child by that best of Rishis? My heart's desire is that my bestowal of you on that wise man may not be fruitless.

sa: स्वस्तिवाच्याहतो विप्रान् दधिपात्रफलाक्षतैः। वसु प्रदाय च ततः प्रदक्षिणमथाकरोत्॥
en: By presenting vessels of curd, fruits and fried rice, he made the Brahmanas utter blessings on him. Presenting them wealth, he walked round them.

sa: विजयस्ते ध्रुवं पार्थ प्रियं काममवाप्स्यसि। इत्युक्तः प्रययौ पार्थः सैन्येन महताऽऽवृतः॥
en: O Partha, victory will surely be yours. Your desires will surely be fulfilled. Vaishampayana said Having been thus addressed, Arjuna, surrounded by a large number of troops, started (for conquest).

sa: तद्वाक्यसमकालं तु बीभत्सुनिशितैः शरैः। अवार्यैः पञ्चभिर्दाहं मग्नमभ्यस्याताडयत्॥
en: As soon as he uttered these words, Bibhatsa (Arjuna) struck the alligator under the water with five sharp and irresistible arrows.

sa: सान्त्वमानार्थदानैश्च पूजया चानुरूपया। सोदर्यां पूजयामास स्वसारं पन्नगोत्तमः॥
en: O Brahmana, the best of the snakes then adored his sister with best regards, with fitting eulogies and gifts of wealth.

sa: ततस्तं पितरस्तात विज्ञाय कुलनन्दनम्। पितृलोकादुपागम्य सर्व ऊचुरिदं वचः॥
en: On learning what their son was doing in order to gratify their race, the Pitris all came to him from their region and said.

sa: बृहन्नामाष्टमस्तेषां कालेयानां नराधिप बभूव राजा धर्मात्मा सर्वभूतहिते रतः॥
en: O king, the eighth of the Kaleyas, who was known as Brihata became a virtuous king, ever engaged in doing good to all creatures,

sa: अग्नेवर्चनमाज्ञाय मातुर्धर्मज्ञतां च वः। भवतां च परं वीर्यं पूर्वं नाहमिहागतः॥
en: On account of those words of Agni and also knowing the virtuous character of your mother and the great effulgence that are in you, I did not come here earlier.

sa: वैराग्निदीपनं चैव भृशमुद्धेगकारि च। सुव्रता चापि कल्याणी सर्वभूतेषु विश्रुता॥ अरुन्धती महात्मानं वसिष्ठं पर्यशरूत। विशुद्धभावमत्यन्तं सदा प्रियहिते रतम्॥ सप्तर्षिमध्यगं धीरमवमेने च तं मुनिम्। अपध्यानेन सा तेन धूमारुणसम्प्रभा। लक्ष्यालक्ष्या नाभिरूपा निमित्तमिव पश्यति॥
en: They inflame the fire of hostility and cause great anxiety. Even the auspiciously blessed and well behaved Arundhati, ever renowned among all creatures felt jealousy against the illustrious and pure minded Vasishtha, ever devoted to the greatly good of his wife. She insulted even that Rishi, one of the seven (great Rishis, the mind born sons of Brahma). On account of her that insulting thought, she has become a little star and looks like fire covered with smoke, sometimes visible and sometimes invisible, as if she is an evil omen.

sa: सा तान् कुशलिनः सर्वान् विमुक्ताञ्जातवेदसः। रोरूयमाणान् ददृशे वने पुत्रान् निरामयान्॥
en: She found that all of them had escaped from the conflagration and they were all well. Seeing their mother, they too began to weep, although they were safe and well.

sa: भूतं हित्वा च भाव्यर्थे योऽवलम्बेत् स मन्दधीः। अवमन्येत तं लोको यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु॥
en: He who casts off that which he has for the sake of what he may acquire(in future) is a wicked man. The world disregards and insults him. As for myself, you are at liberty to do what you choose.

sa: त्वत्त एताः पुनः शुक्र वीरुधो हरितच्छदाः। जायन्ते पुष्करिण्यश्च सुभद्रश्च महोदधिः॥
en: O Shukra, these plants and creepers with green leaves have all sprung through you. These tanks and ponds and the ever blessed great ocean also, have all sprung from you.

sa: अलंकृतामाभरणौर्विरजोऽम्बरसंवृताम्। दृष्टपूर्वामपि स तां नाभ्यजानात् स शान्तनुः॥
en: Shantanu could not recognise that beautiful lady, bedecked with ornaments and attired in fine robes, though he had seen her before.

sa: अयं तिष्ठतु ते विप्र यदीच्छसि महोदधौ। मन्युजोऽग्निर्दहन्नापो लोका ह्यापोमयाः स्मृताः॥
en: O Brahmana, if you desire it, let this fire of your wrath remain in the great ocean, consuming its water, for we have heard the worlds are made of water.

sa: विरूपाक्षस्तु दैतेयश्चित्रयोधी महासुरः। चित्रधर्मेति विख्यातः क्षितावासीत्स पार्थिवः॥
en: The great Asura, capable of displaying various modes of fight and known as Virupaksha, became known as king Chitradharman on earth.

sa: तेन यज्ञेन शुभ्रेण हूयमानेन शक्तिजः। तद्विदीपितमाकाशं सूर्येणेव धनात्यये॥
en: Like the sun emerged from the clouds, the firmament was illuminated by that stainless sacrifice in which large were the libation of ghee poured.

sa: सुराणां सम्मतो नित्यमसुराणां च भारत। उशना वेद यच्छास्त्रमयं तद् वेद सर्वशः॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, both the celestial and the Asuras look on him with favour. Whatever the Vedas and Shastras are known to Ushanas (Shukra) are all known to this boy.

sa: यस्त्वश्व इति विख्यातःश्रीमानासीन्महासुरः। अशोको नाम राजाभून्महावीर्योऽपराजितः॥
en: The great and fortunate Asura who was known as Ashva, became the invincible king Ashoka of great prowess.

sa: स चिन्तयन्नेव तदा दाशकन्यां महीपतिः। प्रत्ययाद्धास्तिनपुरं कामोपहतचेतनः॥
en: That lord of the earth returned to Hastinapur, thinking of the daughter of the fisherman and his heart afflicted by desire.

sa: शापाद्वि शक्तेर्वासिष्ठ तदा तदुपपादितम्। आत्मजेन स दोषेण शक्तिति इतो दिवम्॥
en: O son of Vasishtha, what befell your father all came upon him on account of his own curse. It was for his own fault that Shakti was taken to haven.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच मुहूर्तमिव तं द्रोणाश्चिन्तयित्वा विनिश्चयम्। सव्यसाचिनमादाय नैषादि प्रति जग्मिवान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon Drona reflected for a moment and resolved upon the course he should adopt. He then took Savyasachi (Arjuna) with him and went to the Nishada (prince).

sa: ध्यायन्निव च मां राजन्नाभिभाषसि किंचन। न चाश्वेन विनिर्यासि विवर्णो हरिणः कृशः॥
en: O king, deep in your own thoughts, you do not speak a word to me in reply. You do not now go out on horse back. You are pale and emaciated and discoloured.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ते तमाज्ञाय तत्त्वेन पुनरागम्य पाण्डवाः। यथावृत्तं वने सर्वं द्रोणायाचख्युरद्भुतम्॥
en: Vaishmpayana said : The Pandavas, having made themselves acquainted with everything connected with him and returning (to Hastinapur) told Drona all about the wonderful feat of archery they had seen in the forest.

sa: सर्वेषां चैव दिव्यानामस्तत्राणामप्रसन्नताम्। नाशं वृष्णिकलत्राणां प्रभावानामनित्यताम्॥
en: He also saw unpropitiousness of his celestial weapons. Seeing that it was impossible to protect the Yadu women.

sa: एकलव्य उवाच निषादाधिपतेर्वीरा हिरण्यधनुषः सुतम्। द्रोणशिष्यं च मां वित्त धनुर्वेदकृतश्रमम्॥
en: The Ekalavya said : O heroes, I am the son of the Nishada king, Hiranyadhanu. know me to be a pupil of Drona labouring to acquire the science of arms.

sa: अभ्यगच्छत् तदैवाशु वृद्धामात्यं पितुर्हितम्। तमपृच्छत् तदाभ्येत्य पितुस्तच्छोककारणम्॥
en: He then went to the old minister, devoted to his father's welfare. He asked him the cause of his father's sorrow.

sa: तं शापमनुसंस्मृत्य पर्यतष्यद् भृशं तदा। एतस्मात् कारणाद् राजा वसिष्ठं संन्ययोजयत्। स्वदारेषु नरश्रेष्ठ शापदोषसमन्वितः॥
en: O best of kings, recollecting the curse, he was very sorry for what he had done. It was for this reason and on account of the Brahmani's curse the king appointed Vasishtha to beget a son on his wife.

sa: ते समाशंसिरे लब्धां श्रियं राज्यं च पाण्डवाः। ब्राह्मणं तं पुरस्कृत्य पाञ्चालीं च स्वयंवरे॥ पुरोहितेन तेनाथ गुरुणा संगतास्तदा। नाथवन्तमिवात्मानं मेनिरे भरतर्षभाः॥
en: Having obtained that Brahmana as their priest, the Pandavas with their mother, constituting the sixth of the Party, thought their wealth and kingdom had been already regained and the daughter of the Panchala king already obtained in the Svaimvara. Those best of the Bharata race, having obtained the preceptor Dhaumya as their priest, considered themselves as placed under a protector.

sa: एतावानत्र दोषो हि नान्यः कश्चन पार्थिवा एतज्जानीहि भद्रं ते दानादाने परंतप॥
en: O king, this is the only objection in the marriage. There is no other. O chastiser of foes, know, this is all I have to say in the matter of bestowal (of Satyavati)"

sa: ईप्सितं तस्य विज्ञाय देवी सुरुचिरानना॥ प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यमेवमेव भविष्यति। राजन्पुरुषभूतस्त्वं स्त्रीभावं न स्मरिष्यसि॥ स्त्रीभूतश्च परं मासं न स्मरिष्यसि पौरुषम्।
en: There upon understanding king's desire, the beautiful goddess Pārvatī, mercifully said: The boon, according to your desire, shall be granted. O king, when you shall attain to the male figure, you shall not remember anything of your female form. And when you shall a assume the charming female figure you shall forget everything of your male state.

sa: अदाहे ह्यश्वसेनस्य दानवस्य मयस्य च। कारणं कीर्तितं ब्रह्मञ्छाकाणां न कीर्तितम्॥
en: O Brahmana, you have narrated the cause of Ashvasena and Danava Maya having been not burnt, but you have not narrated the cause of the Sharangakas having been not burnt.

sa: स्पर्धमानस्तु पार्थेन सूतपुत्रोऽत्यमर्षणः। दुर्योधनं समाश्रित्य सोऽवमन्यत पाण्डवान्॥
en: The son of Suta (Karna), being jealous of Partha (Arjuna), always defied him and being supported by Duryodhana disregarded the Pandavas.

sa: इति वाक्यमुपश्रुत्य तथ्यमित्यमरेश्वरः॥ क्रोधामर्षों समुत्सृज्य सम्प्रतस्थे दिवं तदा।
en: Having ascertained these words to be true, the lord of the immortals Indra gave up his wrath and jealousy and went back to heaven.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तदा भीष्मो भारद्वाजमभाषत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed, Bhishma thus spoke to the son of Bharadvaja.

sa: तत्र नानाप्रकारेषु विमानेषु स्वलंकृताः। स्पर्धमानास्तदान्योन्यं निषेदुः सर्वपार्थिवाः॥
en: In them lived all the kings, adorned with various kinds of ornaments and each boasting to get possession of the maiden.

sa: बुधस्य माधवो मासस्तामिलां रुचिराननाम्। गतो रमयतोऽत्यर्थं क्षणवत्तस्य कामिनः।।।
en: And living in the company of Ilā, having a graceful countenance, Budha, possessed by desire, spent the entire month of Madhu like a moment.

sa: अश्मवर्षेण महता भृत्यास्ते विनिपातिताः। त्वं चाश्रमपदे सुप्तो वातवर्षभयादितः॥
en: All your followers have been destroyed by a downpour of huge rocks; yourself, being afraid of the storm, was also asleep in the hermitage.

sa: कृष्णमभ्युद्यतास्त्रं च नादं मुमुचुरुल्बणम्। तेन नादेन रौद्रेण नादेन च विभावसोः॥
en: The whole of the firmament resounded with a terrible roar and with also the roar of the fire, as when the clouds roar at the time of the great dissolution.

sa: अंशुमांश्चेकितानश्च श्रेणिमांश्च महाबलः। समुद्रसेनपुत्रश्च चन्द्रसेनः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Angshumana, Chekitana, the mighty Srinimana, Chandrasena, the son of the mighty Subhadrasena both the father and the son,

sa: निवर्तमानं तं दृष्ट्वा राजानः सर्व एव ते। प्रेक्षकाः समपद्यन्त भीष्मशाल्वसमागमे॥
en: The great car-warrior stopped his car for Shalva and all the kings, also stood there to see him stop. They wished to see the corning combat between Bhishma and Shalva.

sa: द्रोण उवाच एषा मुष्टिरिषीकाणां मयास्त्रेणाभिमन्त्रिता।॥ अस्या वीर्यं निरीक्षध्वं यदन्यस्य न विद्यते। भेत्स्यामीषीकया वीटां तामिषीकां तथान्यया।॥ तामन्यया समायोगे वीटाया ग्रहणं मम।
en: Drona said: I shall by my Mantras invest this handful of Ishikas (long glass) with the virtue of weapons. Behold their virtues that no other weapons possess. I shall piece the ball with one of these blades and then pierce that blade with another and that another with a third and thus making a chain, I shall bring it up.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कृपस्यानुमते ब्रह्मन् भिक्षामाप्नुहि शाश्वतीम्॥ एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच प्रहस्य भरतानिदम्।
en: Yudhisthira said : O Brahinana, ask from us with the permission of Kripa that which would last you for life. Having been thus addressed, (Drona) smiling replied to the princes,

sa: दैत्याः सुपर्णाश्च महोरगाश्च देवर्षयो गुह्यकाश्चारणाश्च। विश्वावसुर्नारदपर्वतौ च गन्धर्वमुख्याः सहसाप्सरोभिः॥
en: There came also the Daityas, the Suparnas, the great Nagas, the celestials Rishi, the Guhyakas, the Charanas, Vishvavasu, Narada, Parvata and the chief Gandharvas with the Apsaras.

sa: सौतिरुवाच तत आहूय पुत्रं स्वं जरत्कारुर्भुजंगमा। वासुकेर्नागराजस्य वचनादिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Sauti said : The snake-lady, Jaratkaru, then calling her son, told him what was spoken to her by Vasuki, the king of the Nagas.

sa: तेषामतिव्याहरतां शस्त्रवर्षं प्रमुञ्चताम्। प्रममाथोत्तमाङ्गानि बीभत्सुनिशितैः शरैः॥
en: Though they rained a fearful shower of weapons, Vivatsu (Arjuna) cut off their heads with his sharp arrows,

sa: यत्राभिमन्युं बहवो जजुरेकं महारथाः। जयद्रथमुखा बालं शूरमप्राप्तयौवनम्॥
en: The death of the boy-hero, Abhimanyu in his teens, alone and unsupported at the hand of many great car-warriors including Jayadratha.

sa: ततो राजा महावीर्यो जरासंधो महाबलः। धनुषोऽभ्याशमागत्य तस्थौ गिरिरिवाचलः॥
en: Thereupon the greatly strong and powerful king Jarasandha came to the bow and stood there for some time, fixed and motionless like a mountain.

sa: सिद्वार्थाश्च सुराः सर्वे प्राप्यामृतमनुत्तमम्। भ्रातरं मे पुरस्कृत्य पितामहमुपागमन्॥
en: The celestials, having their object gained, for they had obtained the excellent Ambrosia, came to the Grandsire, placing my brother (Vasuki) at the head.

sa: देवराजोऽपि तं दृष्ट्वा संरब्धं समरेऽर्जुनम्। स्वमस्त्रमसृजत् तीव्र छादयित्वाखिलं नभः॥
en: Seeing Arjuna in wrath, the king of the celestial also sought to fight with him. He hurled his very fearful weapons and covered whole of the sky.

sa: विनिम्ननिशितैर्बाणै रथाद्भीष्ममपातयत्। शरतल्पगतश्चैव भीष्मो यत्र बभूव ह॥
en: Wounded Bhishma with his sharpest arrows and felled him from his chariot and how Bhishma lay on his bed of arrows.

sa: मैवं जीर्णमुपास्स्व त्वं सख्यं भवत्वपाकृधि। आसीत् सख्यं द्विजश्रेष्ठ त्वया मेऽर्थनिबन्धनम्॥
en: Do not therefor stick to our worn-out friendship. Do not think of it any longer. O best of Brahmanas, the friendship I entertained for you was for a particular purpose.

sa: एतच्छुत्वा तु वचनं वासुकिः पन्नगोत्तमः। प्रादान्माममरप्रख्य तव पित्रे महात्मने।॥
en: Jaratkaru said : The best of snakes, Vasuki, having heard this, O illustrious son, bestowed me on your noble father, long before the commencement of this sacrifice.

sa: शकटांश्च बहून्पूर्णान्फलमूलांश्च शोभनान्। वाल्मीकिवाटे रुचिरे स्थापयन्नविदूरतः॥
en: Inside the highly charming cottage of Vālmīki they placed his picturesque car full of various fruits and roots.

sa: एतत् सुबहुवृत्तान्तं पञ्चमं पर्व भारते। उद्योगपर्व निर्दिष्टं संधिविग्रहमिश्रितम्॥
en: These are the matters that have been dwelt on, the fifth Parva of the Bharata in full of incidents regarding both peace and war.

sa: पुलहस्य सुता राजञ्च्छलभाश्च प्रकीर्तिताः। सिंहाः किंपुरुषा व्याघ्रा ऋक्षा ईहामृगास्तथा॥
en: O king, the offspring of Pulaha were, it is said, the Shalabhas (the winged-insects) the lions, the Kimpurushas (half lions and half men) tigeres, bears and wolves.

sa: ततो नमुचिहा क्रुद्धो भृशमर्चिष्मतस्तदा। पुनरेव महामेधैरम्भांसि व्यसृजद् बहु॥
en: The slayer of Namuchi (Indra) becoming very angry with Agni, again collected many more masses of clouds and made them shower a heavy down-pour.

sa: न मे वागनृतं प्राह स्वैरेष्वपि कुतोऽन्यथा। तं वै नृपवरं गत्वा दीक्षितं जनमेजयम्॥ वाग्भिर्मङ्गलयुक्ताभिस्तोषयिष्येऽद्य मातुल। यथा स यज्ञो नृपतेनिवर्तिष्यति सत्तम॥
en: None can say that my words even in jest have ever been false, not to speak of my words on serious occasions. O uncle, going to that best of kings, Janamejaya, now installed in the sacrifice, I shall please him with words mixed with blessings, so that, O excellent one, that king will refrain from the sacrifice.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तेभ्यः स्वयमेवान्ववेक्ष्य च। खाण्डवस्य विमोक्षार्थं प्रययौ हरिवाहनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard this and himself seeing what Agni was doing, the slayer of Vitra (Indra) set out to save the creatures from the fire.

sa: शमार्थे याचमानस्य पक्षयोरुभयोर्हितम्। दम्भोद्भवस्य चाख्यानमत्रैव परिकीर्तितम्॥
en: An offer which was for the benefit of both parties. Then is related the the story of Dambhodbhava;

sa: इमास्तन्त्रीः सुमधुराः स्थानं वापूर्वदर्शनम्। मूर्च्छयित्वा सुमधुरं गायतां विगतज्वरौ॥
en: O Kuśa and Lava, in your proper mood do you sing the sweet song with charming Murchanā accompanied by the sweet notes of Vīņā.

sa: स तत्र वारितो द्वास्थैः प्रविशन्द्विजसत्तमः। अभितुष्टाव तं यज्ञं प्रवेशार्थी परंतपः॥
en: But the best of Brahmanas, (Astika) was denied admittance by the door-keepers, and the mighty ascetic, wishing to enter into the (enclosed sacrificial place), pleased them (by praising the sacrifice).

sa: शरीरैरपरे दीप्तैर्देहवन्त इवाग्नयः। अदृश्यन्त वने तत्र प्राणिनः प्राणिसंक्षय॥
en: In that great massacre of creatures in that forest, the burning bodies of various animals looked as if Agni had assumed to many forms.

sa: तत्र संसक्तमनसो भरद्वाजस्य धीमतः। ततोऽस्य रेतश्चस्कन्द तदृषिोण आदधे॥
en: Mind of the wise Bharadvaja was attracted to her and his vital fluid was dropped. But he held it in a Drona (a vessel).

sa: तेजसा सूर्यसंकाशा ब्रह्मलोकपरायणाः। इत्येष वंशप्रभवः कथितस्ते तरस्विनाम्। असुराणां सुराणां च पुराणे संश्रुतो मया॥ एतेषां यदपत्यं तु न शक्यं तदशेषतः। प्रसंख्यातुं महीपाल गुणभूतमनन्तकम्॥
en: They were as effulgent as the sun himself. They were always engaged in acquiring the regions of Brahma. Thus have I narrated to you, as I heard them from the Purana, the accounts of the progeny of the Devas and the Danavas of great strength and power. The sons and grandsons, of these (Devas and Danavas) were so numberless that I am incapable of counting them.

sa: विराटनगरे गत्वा श्मशाने विपुलां शमीम्। दृष्ट्वा सन्निदधुस्तत्र पाण्डवा ह्यायुधान्युत॥
en: It described how the Pandavas arrived at the city of Virata and saw a Shami tree in a cremation ground on which they kept hidden their weapons.

sa: गणः क्रोधवशो नाम क्रूरकर्मारिमर्दनः। दनायुषः पुनः पुत्राश्चत्वारोऽसुरपुङ्गवाः॥
en: Their race was wrathful, of crooked deeds and the persecutors of foes. Danayu had four sons, the best among the Asuras.

sa: घोषयात्रा च गन्धर्वैर्यत्र बद्धः सुयोधनः। ह्रियमाणस्तु मन्दात्मा मोक्षितोऽसौ किरीटिना॥
en: The procession of the calves and the ! captivity of Duryodhana at the hands of Gandharvas. His rescue by Arjuna when the wretch was being carried away.

sa: दह्यतस्तस्य च बभौ रूपं दावस्य भारत। मेरोरिव नगेन्द्रस्य कीर्णस्यांशुमर्तोऽशुभिः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, that burning forest looked like, the resplendent Meru, the king of the mountains, blazing with the rays of the sun falling on it.

sa: शर्मिष्ठोवाच ऋषिरभ्यागतः कश्चिद् धर्मात्मा वेदपारगः। स मया वरदः कामं याचितो धर्मसंहितम्॥
en: Sharmishtha said: A Rishi of virtuous mind, learned in the Vedas, came to me. He was capable of granting boons and he was solicited by me to grant my wishes based on virtue.

sa: यौ तौ कुमाराविव कार्तिकेयौ द्वावश्विनेयाविति मे वितर्कः। न्मया श्रुताः पाण्डुसुताः पृथा च॥
en: The two other youths, each as handsome as Kartikeya, are, I am sure, the son of the twin Ashvinis. I heard that sons of Pandu and Pritha had escaped from the fire of the lac house.
